ā, f. (tlenamon) a woman thief: im da banga-
taidi, no im da tlenamnaigh do batar ag Meidb, O'Dav.
1556. Or perhaps leg. tlenamnaid.

[ā, f.] vn. of tlenaid. act of taking away : ar thlena-
mhain dia chionn cedmhuintire, Eriu xiii 18.4 = O'Dav.
1553.

protection, comfort, strength (mostly in chevilles): t. .i.
tlacht, O'Cl. ni tlī tlāith cumtaig ar cest `nicht als schwachen
Trost hat er unser Anliegen auferbaut' (Meyer, Wortk.
129, p. 952.1.), SR 1103. il lurg int slúaig, trúag a tli, 3443.
trúagdai garbdai cen nach t., 5797. bai crú garb dar corp
cen t., SR 5893. cen t. tarba, foraig thaig | niptar amra
oentadaig, 6539. Ri ni tlaith a t., 7549. tricho bliadan
dam cen t. | i n-aes ocus dīmlithi, Fianaig. 40.2. Patric,
ni triamain a t., Met. Dinds. iv 98.97. ind ōcbad dond
humallōit | feib rothā (rosta v.l.) a t.
according to their
strength, Arch. iii 314 § 26. macc Malleōn, ba tolcda a t.,
ZCP xii 377.16. ba talc tli diar triathaib | cath Átha nĪ
uathaig `a stout comfort to our lords,' 437.1. Tuathal Techt
cen tam co t., LL 132a13. Nathí trensheng cosin t., 132b4.
ro tenna co trocha thli | la Cellach Locha Cimmi, 133a6.
timgoire trāth conotlí, BColm. 100.10.

eg.p:
dochuatar iar sétaib slain | ... co trén tluachtar
dar cach tír | coruactar cosinn ardríg, SR 3539.

egForm.p:
[u, m.] (cf. W. tlws) cattle, property: tlas no t. .i. áirnéis
no spréidh, O'Cl. is fair nodusbera a th. | for íoc ocus aith-
rechus, Anecd. ii 70.6. cidh é fein fofuair mu th. | sech
rombiathus romeitiss, 71.5. ba buaid tlossa ocus tascair,
Met. Dinds. iii 54.19. cach forba togad ar th. | ar brogad for
sin turus, 236.23. smacht ┐ tairgille, fuillem ┐ t., H.3.17, col.
439 (O'Don. 559). t. .i. spreid, ut est, gnithi manach beo-
tlusach bunaid, H.3.18, 416 (O'C. 967). in breithemnacht ...
fil for t., H.3.18 446a (O'C. 1098). dogníat na manaigh les n-eclaisi
cona tlusaibh, O'Dav. 1530. fer ro ba saidhbhre i nErinn
a mbeó-t., FM iv 1128.20. ? a rombúi i tighib moruib
maic Daire dāil-sium deogaib corma [sic leg.] cuich sgeo
fin fri mac greche con con t., Ériu ii 5.10.

[u, m.] lie, falsehood: tlus .i. brég, O'Cl. treicfithi
Teamair gan t. | ba Emuin bias bar n-arus, Fen. 218.1.
searrach da gach groigh gan t. | o Laoghan go Cenannus,
BNnÉ 269.27. na meic fa tréine gan t. | meic i bhféile ba
follus, L.Cl.A.Buidhe 276.111. is mairg do-chuaidh re
bhar gceird | a dhaoine atá ag deilbh na dtlus
concocting
lies, Measgra D. 13.42. ? To this: mór gus na géige mon
ngnímh | sídh sa dtlus mbréige do-bhér, IGT Decl. ex.
1677.

pity, compassion (?) (O'R.): Potestates, deoda t.,
| is nessam Uirtutibus, SR 539. cansatar, ba deoda in
t. | hili uli cantemus, 4039. fo huaman Dé, dind ar th.
| cen húabar, cen immorbus, 4551. cen athelluch, deoda
t., | d'atherruch i n-immarbus, 7407. ro thidlaic Dia doib
tre t., Todd Nenn. lxix 15.

ā (1 tlus) gains, earns: ised no tlusaither .i. sedh
no thuillter, H.3.18, 446a (O'C. 1098).

eg.p:
ni raibh long gan leónadh ná athbha gan fosgla
ná t. gan tuargaint, CF Eg. 22. Marstrander (Bidrag 14)
explains as a scribal error for *teld-áss (= ON. tjald-áss),
but Pokorny (ZCP xiii 117.27) regards it as an error for
tegdais.
t. .i. liath, no rodan, H.4.22, 67 (O'C. 2067).

egForm.p:
fire (a doubtful word; many of the exx. may belong
to 2 tnú) `aedh' ocus `tnu' teine trá, Met. Gl. 9 § 5. t. .i.
teine, for tnó .i. ar teinidh, O'Cl. nirbo thenn ar t. (: clú)
.i. ar tene, ACC 122 = ciarbo trén ar t. .i. gris, LB 178 lower
marg. do breth cleth chairthind co crú | tre th. issin tech
i taí, LL 35a30 = Rawl. 84a19. drongus, tnu trēn `ein
starkes Lebensfeuer,' Ält. Ir. Dicht. ii 21 § 1. conberbar
bracht i n-ebron bru | feisi cen lacht, mennán for tnu,
O'Dav. 1026. tnu .i. coicilt, ut est briathar techt tene i
tnu .i. madh ísin briathar techta bitt amal tine i coclad i
tnu .i. it ana coicelta, 1590. ? rig Themra dia tesband t.
| ad fessam a n-aidedu, LL 131b34.

(? = tnúth, q.v. Form well attested by rhyming exx.)
envy: cipia frisa ferthar t. (: trú), Ériu v 211.69. ba tarb
tnu fri gleo, fri cath, SR 3895. dobert ainech ris tre th.
| dú ita Ailech indiu, Met. Dinds. iv 94.27. tairm cen t.
(: didu), ii 32.81. mag techt cen t., LL 15b39. robo rí don
ro-Banba | .vii. mbliadan fo thrí cen t. (: mumú), 18a30.
? luidseom sunn | tarclam tnū | sūainem Segsa | coclann
cū, Ält. Ir. Dicht. i 56 § 36. ? cribais mara Talláin tair
| benais ri ail tairges tnú (: tú), IT i 163.3. ? hi cert ri
norainte adiú | nín bo tercli toillte tnu, BB 45a19.

hi mmuigh Turidh turim gan t. | adrocair cuing
catha, BB 33b55.

form.p:
o and u, m. , ā, f. tnúith, ā, f. IGT Decl. §§ 39,
45 , 46.

eg.p: (a) rage, fury: bam tarb tnúith isna tressaib, TFerbe 647.

egForm.p:
(b) envy, jealousy: cóir are re dígail Dé | mairgc romí-
dhair bid fa t[h]núth, BColm. 100.5. cen mebail cen
mélacht cen t., LU 2296. bai t. mór oc Mugaind for Mairind,
4222. bá sa hairthiur fofertais a tnútha, Ériu iv 163.3.
taom tnútha, v 78.18. dogabh t. ┐ formad í, 78.13. na dena
tnuth re duine diabhlaidhi, 126 § 17 . nī theilce Ultu di
thnuthaib tairperta tarcoba a gāri, TBC² 1015. ragaid
dála i tnutha, Eg. 88, fo. 21 (22)a (O'C. 2280). maith an
locht airdríogh óige | t. cáigh ris is romhóide, DDána
105.1. ní thóigeba t. aoinfhir ... th'oirdned orra mar
airdríg, O'Gr. Cat. 470.19. teacht fa mhúith a muigh
neamhdha | do mhuin tnúith ré a Thighearna, Dán Dé
xiv 13. síol nEabha ag toibhéim tré th., xxvi 26. nar
ghnáthaigh taom tnúidh, PBocht 5.56. creud as tnuth
ann ? Doilghes fa mhaith na comharsan, Luc. Fid. 154.16.
As quasi vn. act of envying: ag tnúith rem aithgin eile,
475.20.

(c) desire, greed: indi bíte fri tnúith ┐ adellad ilsétchi,
Mon. Tall. 132.1. coimpleit dúinne gabhaidh greim | i
n-aghaidh tnúidhe mar thuirmhim, Dán Dé xxiv 4. tig
dún ... | tnúdh ré séadaibh saoghalta, A. Ó Dálaigh xxxix 6.
iongnadh ár dtnúith ris an olc, ITS xi 6 § 11. Cf. trebad
tnúith avaricious, stingy service: marbhnat Dé - ní
treabhadh tnúidh | garmac dúinn é - dleaghar dhínn, Dán
Dé xxvi.2. ní [dhlé] a bhos treabhadh [an] tnúidh, PBocht
7.2.

eg.p:
(d) affection, love: led dhíol as tuar tnúdha `by thy
merits which stir my love' A. Ó Dálaigh iv 6. flaith corónta
chosnus tnúdh `who wins devotion,' Studies 1919, 75 § 18.
is tusa ar tigernai-ne (sic leg.) tnuidh, IT iii 80 § 55. cainnt
chiúin, radharc tnúith, aghadhghnúis iongantach uain,
Hackett xxxii 2. ato im thost im thnúth, PRIA xix C
548 § 26.

(e) act of striving for, seeking: ni cluintear tnúdh le cor
gcosgair, DDána 110.54. tnúdh re t'uilli a n-imresnaibh
| as rún duine deighmeisnigh, IGT Decl. ex. 386. acht
amáin go bfuigbe a fher tnútha dá thréinmilled, Caithr.
Thoirdh. 59.13. is fada mé a g-cúmhaidh gan t. le téurma,
Hard. ii 32.4. As vn.: atáid mná moighe hEamhna ... ag
tnúidh faghála a bhfaghthaoi, L.Cl.A. Buidhe 208. 8. síad
ag t. mar theguid d'fhoraois | agha torrcha ó dtuismhid
laoigh, xxxviii 117. díol airgid le búir ag tnúith le na
g-carrdus, Poets and Poetry of Munster, 2nd Series (1860)
20.3. Hence act of expecting, expectancy: hi cuis tnutha
`in a state of expectation,' Rel. Celt. ii 270.37. atá t.
agam nach sgaoilfidh aon don cheathrar sin iad, Oss. iii 96.16.

(f) act of emulating, contending; emulation: oc t. imon
tigernus friu, LB 121b15. roeirig tnuth ┐ trenchosnum
eturu im rigi na Tebe, TTebe 141. bai imchosnum ┐ tnuth
mor eter B. ┐ F. desin, RC xxiv 180.10. níor ghar tnúdh
[rem] thighearna, A. Ó Dálaigh lii 11. déanam tnúdh re
tréidhibh Eoin | do dhéinimh eoil dúnn 'n-a dhiaidh,
PBocht 27.11. níor comhainm ris nach cóir tnúith, DDána
91.41. i gcleas tnútha, i lúth nó i lámhach, Hackett xl 241.
mór mo thnúith-se lem thoil féin | ó thanag tar tuinn
n-aigéin, lxiii 1.

egForm.p:
Compds. bara fierce rage: s a tnuthbhara ag Manaind
min, BB 53a9. burach ? : coná ro sguirsed ... do'n tnuth-
burach trascartha tren-fher, MR 256.12. chomarthach
eager (?) : rucsad sum da tren-redg ... t., MR 298.17. gail
fierce valour: is tríath tailc tnuthgaile, LU 8960 (FB 71).
gort field of contention: méad mo cheanfhaghla i dtnúth-
ghort na togharma `in the Field of Summons' (i.e. at
Judgment Day), Studies 1932, 577 § 12. greis act of con-
tending furiously?: is é crīch a ríghbais | bith 'sa cath ag
t. (: glúnglais), Fianaig. 82.6. mer of swift anger: ni
dligh tarbh tnuth-mear trodach a thesargain, MR 122.8.

form.p: o, ā (tnúth, ? 2 tnú).

eg.p:
(a) furious, angry; eager for battle: caín tarb t., Sc.M.²
15.15. bat err tnuthach tairptech, Ériu viii 173.25. trénfer
tnútach amal Triscod, LU 6710 (TBC). cenglathar err
thréntnuthach, LU 8951 (FB 71). tuc léi tarb in t., Met.
Dinds. iv 198.21. bid tnuthach ínn ímthuargain dodenat,
LL 403a3. ro buirset co tnuthach isin chath sin damradh
rochalma, 403a30. bá t. ┐ ba h-inḟir in comrac-sa, RC xiii
458.5. tarb tnuthach, LB 124a26. rogabastar confad
co tnuthach consnumach ... na milead sin, TTebe 376. a
hoireacht thnuthach na Teibi, 880. adchiu-sa da tharb
trena tnuacha, 1617. rugsat meic na righ búrach | tré
cath na ngall co t., Cog. 114.6. tarb-chodnach tnuthach,
MR 254.8. tnuthach .i. deabhthach, O'Cl.

egForm.p:
(b) desirous, envious: is imda lāech maroen rimsa is
tnūthach re troit `eager for fight,' Fianaig. 76.11. gebē
benus a dūthaig (sic leg.) | do neoch ar talmain tnúthaig,
ZCP x 50.31. fer t. toimsedach, H.3.17, col. 657 (O'Don.
926). urusa dhuit déanaimh cean | t. gcogaidh Meic
Mhíleadh, TD 1.45. t. bhfoghla re fada, DDána 92.10.
mad olc leis an tí as t., L. Cl. A. Buidhe 209.40. As subst.
envious person: bí fós teas forloisgthe na feirge i n-aigheadh
an tnúthaigh, TSh. 7917.

form.p:
[ā, f.] (tnúth) as adv.: in tnúdacht gl. contu-
maciter, ZCP vii 491 § 75.

egForm.p:
g (tnúth) envies: ní thnuthaighidh súil re
h-aen gloir eili a flaitheamhnas, ITS xxix 192.8. do tnúth-
nuigheadar re Maóise annsa champa, Ps. cvi 16. ná tnúth-
uigheadh do chroidhe ris na peacacuibh, Prov. xxiii 17.

form.p: poss. pron. 2 s.see do.

egForm.p:
affirm. adv. used in reply to a question, yes, certainly:
`in essar dam do ā ? '| `t., mena, má mó á,' Corm. Y 70.
`ind raibi athcomarc lat ... ?' `t.' ol M., Mon. Tall. 135.29.
in failet hi focus ? olse; to, ar araile, LU 1868. asbert
fris in tairngeredh Adhamnan fochaidi d'feraibh Erenn
... T., ol Colman, Anec. ii 18.22. in dartais do choibsena ?
t. or sí, SG 415.11.

eg.p: Cf. náthó, nítho.

egForm.p:
tongue: toimhes a airbert .i. to tenga ┐ meas airi fen
.i. meas doghnither o theangaidh, Auraic. 751. tó .i. t[e]anga,
Lec. Gl. 237. to .i. teanga, O'Cl.

eg.p: see dó.
see tóe.
see toth.

egForm.p:
io, iā part. of do-fich. destroyed: in nephchath-
aigthe .i. in nephthoachtae ón, Ml 126c22.

(see Gwynn, Ériu xi 150-1) brings forth: tói, no
taoi .i. breith, gur thoí .i. go rug, O'Cl. co ro táe gein meic
(sic leg.), RC xv 429.5. cor' chuinnigh cairde co rothoed a
brú, xvi 45.11. andsu la broind aní bíis ná (sic leg.) aní
thoas, 46.31. corothoí a brú | in-oen-ingin, Met. Dinds.
iii 186.29 (corr.) ? co rothóed in bó-sin | dá lóeg ar in
lúth-sin, iv 70.17. Vn. tóud.

eg.p: Cf. an brú do donnoe, FM i 508.z.

egForm.p:
ā (tóe) is silent: in tan ... no turcbad son a gotha
fessin, no thoad in sluag, Ériu iv 30.22. Cf. in am no
búaled Concobur co fleisc rígda in stéill, contóitis Ulaid
uile fris, IT i 310.2.

eg.p: See tá, tóe.

egForm.p:
o,[m.] (< Lat. tuba) trumpet: cosmulius tuib arataat
ilsenman, Wb 12c46. t. di humu fo chosmailius nadarcae
side gl. tubam corneam, Ml 2b16. ro sente tuib (no stuic),
Alex. 494 (BB excerpts.).

eg.p:
Compd. chetal trumpet music: ised tobchetal nime in
torainn, Ml 40d7. air no cainte tobchetal leu som hi tosuch
cech mís gl. canite initio mensis tuba, 102c8.

egForm.p:
(Perh. Eng. tub) drinking vessel: ag comhól ar a chéile
dá gcoidhinibh béil-fhliucha blaithche is dá dtobannaibh
mór-chluasacha meidhge, DDána 111.24.

o, m. vn. of do-boing. Original meaning
probably act of cutting, reaping, removing (see do-boing) ;
cf. fordascid Cormac dano ic topagsin urluachra, RC xxv
35.22.

(a) act of levying, enforcing (fines, contracts, etc.): oc
tobuch a císa, LU 10435. co airm i fail ac tobuch a chisa,
CRR § 7. atait secht tobaig a tuaith naco ndlegat dire na
fiacha, Laws v 178.1. cach tobaig a train, iii 316.x. coe-
machtu tobaig dligtig, 240.12 Comm. do-fet aurfocra cach
n-athgaba[i]l(a) la Féine, inge ma[d] do nemthib no ma[d]
for nemthib; to-fet troscud a t. saide, ZCP xv 261 § 1 =
Laws i 112.14. is remtectacu lium troscad orraside na t.
athgabala dib, Laws i 114.7 Comm. noco teit dar cuitidh
tobaig na criche, iii 218.22 Comm. cor tobuig forced contract,
v 214.x. cor tobaig (sic leg. MS. tobad) .i. etechta, .i. ni
nad nascar etir, ut dicitur in loingsech morieris nisi dediris,
O'C. 838 (H.3.18, 382b). do t. ind nadma ro naisc, Laws
i 138.25 Comm. conicfad t. a fiach o mudh aile, v 256.22
Comm. tri ruighlis ollamhan filidh .i. ... t. do tuathaib,
O'Don. 1196 (H.2.15, 79b). ropat laxa a thobaig, Tec.
Cor. § 6.48. áes tobaig `tax-gatherers,' Ériu ii 210 § 33.
maor tabhaigh na Tríonóide, Dán Dé xiv 5. brughaidh fri
doimhiadh do dhioghoilt monab tualoing ttabhoigh, ZCP
x 278.6. acra, tobuch frithir fíach | écnach, écraite, anríad,
Met. Dinds iii 18.221. an cïs aíngid ētrocar sin boī acu ica
thabhach, RC x 185.z. robói do tressi a thigernais ┐ do
thenne a thabaig
so severely did he exact tribute, ZCP xiii
196.15. beith ua rigi ┐ ua rigsmacht in rig ac buileam ...
┐ ua tamach ┐ ua tomaitteam in rig araill, TTebe 231.
flaithi re fosugad ┐ maithi re mughugad ┐ treoin re tap[h]ach,
ML² 1191. do thuigestair C. nār t[h]rēn tabaigh a aicme ar
cairdib clainni S., 1758. atā aniudh ag tabach ēaruca
ar an bfear ros mharuh hē, Feis TC 231. Aed mac Toirr-
delbaig do thecht istir ┐ braigdi Connacht do thabach do,
Ann. Conn. 1351.3. oc tabach slog-socraite collecting,
LB 153b49. ag tabhach a thighearnais forra, FM iv 862.17.
Of Doomsday: maor Dé bhí nocha buidheach | sé ag
fuireach go dtí an tobhach, Dán Dé vii 30. lá an tobhaigh,
xvii 13. fád chóir féin uainn do thabhach `to exact Thy
due from us,' Ó Bruad. ii 122 § xliii. do t. in tiri ocus na
cumaile a tuaid, Laws i 74.25 Comm. olc an gaol do shíol
Shuibhne | tabhach Fódla féarghuirme, TD 26.42. Of
the amount levied: trian eineaclainn, trian tabhaigh |
trian cána chláir Fhearadhaigh, TD 9.13. ┐ ni raibi baili
... cen gnathbuana, na tuath cin tabach, Ann. Conn. 1310.6.
cinuid sin do nach dlegar cis no cain no t. no geill, Cog. 54.6.

eg.p:
(b) act of rescuing: do thabhach mh'anma a hIofarann,
Dán Dé xxv 64. adubhradur co rachduis do thabh-
ach mna rí na Sisaile, St. Ercuil 706. sluaigedh mor ... do
thabach Briain ar hUa Raighilligh, AU iii 254.6. Emann
mac Riocaird a Burc do gabhail a meabhail lá Bairédachaibh
┐ a thabhach go haitheasach dia braithribh fein, FM iv
1150.21.

(c) act of seeking, demanding, wresting: fuil Crist do
thabach dia clannaib di-a n-eisi `for their descendants after
them to pay for the blood of Christ,' PH 3286. ni i n-Affraic
... atu accut tobuch no accat tinnenus `am I importuning
thee,' CCath. 3303. beantar teinte a taobhaibh cloch |
rém bualadh ná bí ag tobhach, Content. viii § 12. do tho-
bhach breitheamhnuis, Exod. xxiii 2.

egForm.p:
o, ā (? tóbae) cut, cropped ? (of hair): folt t. dergbudi
i forchengul, MU² 532. co fult t. dergbuide fair, 30.16.
folt findbuide issé cass dess drumnech t. far-ide, TBC 5173.
folt dond t. fair, 5322. folt ... tobach druimneach corici
ath a da gualand, TBC² 3146.

io, n. vn. of do-fuiben. act of cutting, cutting down,
removing: tóbe vitiorum assa anmin, Wb 2c7. iarna tóbu,
5b41. in fid do thóbu, 42. ni a tobae namma fil and dogní
da salm de, Ml 26c2. nírbu mou leu bríg a tobai indate
bitis cranna doiscairi do fubaitis, 92d6. is in tobu gl. in
praecisione, 37d8. tobe gl. exterminatio, ZCP vii 487 § 19.
tre th. `by concision,' Sg. 119b2. tóbe gl. elesionem, 214b3.
teilm ... .i. tobae iall, Corm. Y 1215. toba damna .i. iar-
sinni teipiter damna na focul eistib, Auraic. 414. toba
ndamna, 419.

eg.p: io, iā part. of do-fuiben.

egForm.p:
(a) cut, cut short: tobaidib
gl. succissís, Ml 48d13. maniptis tóbaidi in togarthidi
`apocopated,' Sg. 120a1.

(b) defined, selected (cf. teipide) :
tobaidi .i. cinnte, ut est cain-bera do dliged arbera do thur-
baid tobaide .i. tepe[de] .i. cinntí, O'Dav. 1523. cia tugaid
ara neberar berla tobaide din Gaedilg, Auraic. 10. in gnath
berla fogní do chach is e in berla bunaid no is berla topaide,
BB 300b2. As subst. tobaidi do theipu doib asna hilber-
laibh, BB 324a12.

eg.p: see do-boing.

egForm.p:
io,m. (tob) trumpeter: batar tinoltaidhe ┐ topaire
┐ organaigh resna sluagaibh sin, BB 492a34.

vn. from *to-fo-ber-, act of attacking: is mebol damsa
indosso mani fuil imorbága imar tōbairt immuich, MU²
949. do-ralsat óenclár catha foraib dia tōbairt, 955.

gerund from *to-fo-ber-, to be attacked: tófairthe
hifechtso, MU² 1044.

eg.p:
cáin tonna [tige] húi Eogain, íth hi tig húi
Chuind cachthádath tobaraind (cach tadath tobarand,
LB; dobaraind, YBL; cach tratha dobarind, Harl.;
dobarainn, Hy M.), Corm. Bodl. 20.6.

Thurneysen, Windisch Festschrift 29 n. 6 suggests read-
ing tádat and translating `the assailant of every thief.'
see tabarthaid.

egForm.p:
n, n. later m. and f. (to + béim) act of reproaching,
insulting; reproach, insult: bátár ... oc toibeim for Laé-
gairi, LU 8939 (FB 70). do gapsat ic aisc ┐ ic tobeim fair
co mor, CCath. 4445. Síol nEabha ag t. tré thnúth, Dán
Dé xxvi 26. Agatho cen tobeim | a romein de rigraid,
Gorm. Dec. 7. tria t. do thabairt for h-Elesias, LB 131b9.
ticfaid dáil toibéime úaid, Arch. iii 305.2. ní héiccen toi-
bhéim oraibh, Cog. 62.24. do thuilled in tobheime ocus
do thormach na tarcaisi, MR 294.7. tugadur toibhéim
aran ccoimhthionol, BNnÉ 163.27. an béal le dtabhraim
toibhéim, A. Ó Dálaigh xxxix 15. toibhéim ní fhuair a
hóghacht, DDána 6.12. níor ghuais dí ... toibhéim oide
ná adhbhair, 73.32. toibhéim id chainnt re confadh | mar
fhoiléim drainnt dobharchon, Content. xxiv 14. tancatar
can tobem cen tubaist dia tigib misfortune, Ann. Conn.
1403.7. ní hiontugtha toibhéim choitcheann d'Éireann-
chaibh tré bheagán do dhaoinibh domhúinte, Keat. i 62.18.
do gheibh sé toibheim dhó féin, Prov. ix 7. ag siúbhal
gan tobhéim ann uile aitheantaib ... an Tighearna, Donl.
212.25.

eg.p: see tubron.

egForm.p:
u, m. vn. of do-brúchta. act of bursting forth:
in tobrúchto gl. eructationis, Ml 64c15. scamana tescta
ic tobruchtad, CCath. 6097 v.l. togbhail na ráth ┐ tobh-
ruchtadh na n-aibhneadh, FM i 34.20. ba tiopra go ttobh-
rúchtadh a fhéle, iv 664.21. maidhm talmhan do tóbh-
ruchtadh, 1184.15. batar ic tobruchtad coccaid fri Brian
`menacing war,' Cog. 110.1.

eg.p:
(a) fortune, chance: toceth gl. fors, Thes. ii 47.26, 362.28,
KZ xxxiii 75 § 78; cf. RC xiv 229 § 72. sīd ┐ sāegal, toceth
(toice, tocadh v.ll.) ┐ toatha, ZCP xi 87 § 56. t. gl. fors,
Ml 19d5. t. .i. tecmang gl. fors, 35d22. tecmang ł t. (MS.
togad) gl. fors, 39c16. do thoicdib gl. fatis, Sg. 138b6. toccad
cain | coemnae coecat bliadnae, Ält. Ir. Dicht. ii 15 § 1.
cáin in t., LL 119b10. (Cf. tenniu a chuindsciu chaintocud,
BDD² 1020. teora ranna sluinte fri cáintocad, Triads 131).

(b) good fortune, prosperity, wealth: tacud iar-már mui mo
celmaine .i. iar mór thacad regat, is í mo chelmaine dam,
Lib. Hym. i 184.4. in chlí comras cond credail | ollmas
fu thocaid tugaib, Thes. ii 295.3. barc thacid thriūin,
Bruchst. i 8 § 9. taccad .i. ti-caid. i. ar ti cadhussa bis
no ar ti chuad ata, Corm. Y 1250. eitged .i. é gu na thacud
aice in tan na hicud ní ocus ro hictha ní ris, Laws iii 90.6.
cotarói a toccad
their luck can protect them, TBC² 179.
fortés Mél du thocad, ar ni fortachtaig[i] Día nach mifhir
meirb, Trip. 88.29. ol is treisin t. Aedan
since the fortune
of A. is the stronger, Anec. i 4.z. tosach tocuid trebaire,
iii 16.7. athiath tocaid atuibell, IT iii 45.19 = atriat taicid
atuibell, 21. sechthonna tacid, 53.12 = .uíí. tonna taccid,
54.1. cet cranna is crodh fir thaicidh, BB 277a47. rodāl
foraibh Crīst ... imrōl tocaidh ocus ordan, Arch. iii 298 § 64.
buaid ┐ orddan ┐ taiced a trí n-aite, LL 30d58. as mo gais,
as mo thocud, IT i 142.6. tugus fos ... clann ocus tagadh
malle, Fen. 92.13. mac brugad ┐ fhir thacaid ┐ chonaich,
FDG 728. ba trómm tra a thaccad ┐ a chonach beos, PH
826. ro lealtar do taccaid dud mullach, BB 497a17. rith
tagaid atá am gairi | is abaid trá an tarrngaire, IGT Decl.
ex. 726. damad tú tagad crechán | ar brú madadh Maith-
nechán, 727. rug ar thsíl Táil do thaicthib | nach brígh
dháibh a nderrlaicthir, 829. sbéis i dtagadh is dall dún |
a n-abar ann dámadh fíor, Dán Dé xxvi 17. áineas raith
an tagaidh thalmhaidhe, DDána 83.11. tola tuile tocaidh
móir, FM ii 586.21. tocadh, no taccadh .i. sonas, O'Cl.

In salutation: orddan ┐ t. duit, IT i 71.19. ordan ┐ t.
duit, YBL 128a26.

Compd. bennach of prosperous hills ?: a mic Flannacain
i Ceallaigh | a ri in tiri taicedbennaigh, BB 289a50.

egForm.p:
(used only in passive) destines: ma romthoicthersa
inso rop ith ┐ mlicht adcear; manim rothcaither ropat
choin altai ... adcear, Thes. ii 293.6. `Attafēid dam amal
sodain!' ol Conn. `Ni dam rothocad a rād fritt' ol in
drūi
I am not the one appointed to tell thee, ZCP xiii 372.27.
bes ro thacath dim, RC vi 175.32 v.l. = is ed ro cinded dam,
text. ma ratocad damsa, Anec. i 5.18. rotogad (sic leg.
with MS.) duit cairdes frie, Aisl. Óengusso 47.8. ma rom
toiccthi ecc ind Hi, Brussels Adamnan col. 13 (Plummer
MS. notes). is suachnid ni rodchadh (leg. rothcad) mo
iccsa, Ériu xii 168.12.

form.p: Vn. tocad.

earlier tocbál, tucbál ā, f. Vn. of Mid. Ir. do-fócaib,
see Ped. ii 531 and Thurn. Gramm. 526. tógbháil, togbháil,
IGT Verbs § 108. See tecbál, turcbáil.

egForm.p:
(a) act of raising, lifting: la tócbáil a lámi, LU 8536
(FB 39). tindarscan P. a thocbáil súas
to lift up (the veil),
Trip. 168.21. ac tocbail a aigchi forsin rig, Lec. 51va49.
ord fresgabala din, air is ocbail a tocbail ris on grad iseal
cusin ngrad n-uasal, Laws v 26.18 Comm. ica tocbail suas
don tuind, YBL 139b12. do gabh se ag tarraing na crann
asa premuib ┐ ag togbail na cairrgedh co mór cloch da
n-aitibh, St. Ercuil 2531. foillsighthear dhí dul dá dtóg-
bháil | trí cuirp do cuireadh i n-uaigh, Dán Dé iii 29. budh
séan creach dá céadtógbháil, DDána 85.2. togbáil
(: bogláim) a siúil, IGT Verbs ex. 962. droitced togbala a dul
isin cathraigh sin `drawbridge,' ZCP vi 284.19. aderar an
coriandrum do togbáil lanna an croicinn, 23 P 10 i, 40a13.
da mbia in sicne ar na togail suas cuir suil tordoigi ris da
turnum, 23 F 19, 24vb 36. briar .i. delg co tocbail for a
cinn .i. bri tulach handle (Plummer, MS. notes), O'C. 86 (H.3.18,
64). aran tocbala `kneaded bread' (=panis bene subactus),
Rosa Ang. 114.24 (prob. translator understood b. sub-
actus as `well-risen'). Of raising song: ní dligend can-
tairecht cōir | do tōcbāil agun altōir, ZCP viii 115 § 27.
ri tócbail a gotha do'n t-shacart, PH 5337. t. sanaise
revealing of a secret plan made between lord and céle: togbail
sanaisi .i. na flatha dó, ┐ fogail a-ndlesta lan n-eneclaindi
don fiaith ro-chograstar and ┐ ar a meid ro bo dith leis a
indisin air, laneneclann on cheile indti, ZCP xvi 407.17.

eg.p:
(b) act of causing, exciting: fá togbail fergi ┐ fhuasaidi P.
... sin, TTebe 1164. ni heter leisin adhbar urcoideach sin
beth a n-aenball amhain gan teinnus do togbail, 23 P 10
i, 26b14.

(c) act of elevating; exposing, showing: tocbál
(a ocbal, Gwynn) in cailich iarna lándiurug, Thes. ii 253.3.
a toucbail (a thurcbal v.l.) in cech bliadain `that they should
be exposed,' Trip. 240.1. oca aurail do neuch fairsiom
guidhi dé laisiom ┐ tócbale soscéli fris, Mon. Tall. 158.22.
Cengciges airdd Machae cen aigi cen tucbail scrine, AU i
312.4. togbhail chuirp Chriosd, Parrth. Anma 328.5.
tri coicait ban ... do thócbail annochta ┐ annáre dó, TBC
1360. togbhail .i. taisbénadh, O'Cl. Cf. gabaitt for togbail
a fedhmann catha ┐ a ngniomh gaisgidh os áird, Leb. Geb.
i 84.7.

(d) understand (in grammatical tracts; see McKenna,
Bardic Syntactical Tracts 255 ff.): ceart sunnradh uathaidh
┐ iollraidh re thogbháil orra; lochtach gan togbháil iad
`[the phrase] may be singular or plural, the context should
show which,' 256 ex. 13. sunnradh é ┐ iad re thogbáil air
`it may be taken as singular or plural,' 257 ex. 21.

(e) In
phr. t. cind appearing: ingen briugad cétaig cáim | ... do
thócbáil chind, nirbo chol, | don churaid ina chotlod, Met.
Dinds. iii 174.103. nir lamad cend do tocbail doib noco
tancadur da tigib, Ann. Conn. 1348.6.

egForm.p:
(f) act of building:
do tocbail droichit, Laws i 134.26. ar thocbail a mūir, Lec.
70vb38. ní cheil maissi dona mnáib | Temair cen taissi
ar tócbáil, Met. Dinds. i 6.2. trī dūin tenna do thōgbāil,
ML² 1108. Croch Naem do tocbail a manestir na Builli,
Ann. Conn. 1312.8. baile mōr ar n-a thōgbāil, Fl. Earls
78.z. caol-tuir chneas-aolta chloch ... do thógbháil, TSh.
5608. a thógbháil a dtrí lá, Matt. xxvi 61. Used of agent:
tocbháil ceall ┐ cadhus builder, ALC i 192.14.

eg.p:
(g) act of
bringing up, educating: a chomalta aen tige ... ┐ aen togbala,
MR 292.10.

(h) act of extolling, exalting: nipu thacuir
tucbál hic `it were not fitting to extol here,' Ardm. 221r1 (KZ
xxxi 245). naemseanchas naem Indsi Fail | d'eolchaib is
toisc a thocbail, Lec. 49va3. uair as fada atú can mo bladh
do thogbail ag togail na Teibi, TTebe 4062. toircheas na
hóighe is é an fáidh | aice do fhuair a thógbháil, DDána
9.7.

(i) act of upholding, assisting: iar ttóccbháil fedb ┐
iriseach Iosa a ngach ionad, BNnÉ 273 § 248. ro buī ag
cothughadh ┐ ag tōgbāil chreidimh, Fl. Earls 136.23. mé
gach aonbhocht do b'fhíor dáibh | do bhíodh taobhnocht
gan tógbháil, DDána 29.27.

egForm.p:
(j) act of levying: ic tocbail
giall ┐ cana do as cach aird, RC xxiv 180.7. cioscháin
Laighen ... do toccbáil ┐ do thiomsucchad, BNnÉ 264 § 225.
gur chuirsiod a maor ... do thógbháil chíosa ar Sionói-
deachuibh, Hy. Fiachr. 336.3. ma targa giall in fechemun
toicheda gella ocus airge uaidh fén don bidhbuid, ocus nir
gabadh uadh, acht a tocbhail tairis ..., Laws ii 138.12 Comm.
t. comloigthe `Erhebung mit Verrechnung'; t. marbtha
`Erhebung der Tötung' (cf. Bürgschaft 80): cemadh ail
dono do giall in tocbail comloighthi, munup ail do feche-
muin toicheda, ni dingnestur acht togbail marbthu, Laws
ii 144.13 Comm. togbail comloigthe, O'Don. 113 (H.3.17,
col. 91). Of levying troops: maille re a bfuaradar do
thocbáil eli ALC i 522.3. do thógbhaile daoine ar Ghaoidhel-
tacht, Rel. Celt. ii 192.23. feis na Teamhrach do thog-
bhail, ML 80.11. cocluiche do tocbhauil, RC xii 72 § 43.

(k) act of taking, removing: nīr thoill līn a tōgbhāla ... i
n-a timc[h]eall, ML² 18. clocha ┐ ael tigi spitel na Trin-
noite do tocbail chuce, Ann. Conn. 1245.3. tógbail ┐ tin-
feadh anāla a corpaib daenna inhalation, RC xxiv 370.17.
tógbháil móir bhfiadhan ar dáil, Content. xviii 23. do
thógbháil fán dtír amach, Ir. Review 1912, 378 § 5. do
thōgbáil uisque, Fl. Earls 8.9. ro buī a uile chios ┐ tighernus
dia thōgbāil chuige go Flonndrus, 28.25. do thogmháil
chreach, Rel. Celt. ii 196.22. tōgbhail suas ar a mhaoin
levy on, recover from his property, Cín Lae Ó Meall. 20.22. ar
neirghe da narmannuibh ┐ ar tógmháil da ttegmhálibh
`on ... removing their difficulties,' 262.35. antan imdaidter
fas an finda ... ┐ nach furtachtaigenn leiges ele do ase a
togbáil as ferr
remove it, 23 P 10 ii, 40.2.

eg.p:
Cf. docuir tígerna cugud lá togbail cum comruic `to choose
a day for combat,' ZCP vi 59.21.

egForm.p:
o, m. (tócbáil) upholder: togbalach ... tothuchtach
na tuath, AU ii 272.6.

i, m. (tócbáil) upholder: Mag Gormain ... tóg-
bhálaigh trógh, FM v 1652.3. tógbhálaigh tróg ┐ annffann,
vi 1908.9.

io, iā (tócbáil) elevated: trén ┐ toccbalta cach
cuis, CCath. 4497.

o, ā (tócbálta) elevated: tairngertaid tren togh-
baltach ann Éirind, Gwynn Cat. 78.26.

eg.p: see tocraid.

(? toich): cath Cūle, cath Uchbath | ardd bruthgal,
bág toche, Arch. Hib. ii 54 (iii 5.) ba togairm t., Met. Dinds.
iii 344.93. ba tairm t., 458.108. do ríoghanaibh toca
(tocha, v.l.), Ó Bruad. iii 28.9.

egForm.p:
(—ó—?) (<tochell, Gwynn, Ériu vii 184.13, but
cf. tachail) avarice: cen mbrath, cen togāis, cen t.
ZCP iii 26.8 = tóchailche, Ériu vii 154.3.

form.p:
ā, f. vn. of *do-claid and tochlaid.
IGT Decl. § 42. Also tochlad and tochal.

eg.p:
act of digging up, excavating: do t. in talman, CCath.
2517. slicht na tochalta, 2997. conad he Amalgaid ...
doroindi Carn Amalgaid do thochailt cum aenaig, Lec.
72c11. Gaileoin [dorada riu] ona gaib leoin robai aco oc
tachailt na hūiri, 276b2. Fir Domnann o domain-toirnem
na hūiri isna bolcaib ┐ Gaileoin ona tachailt, 277a35. t.
na tulcha, Laws i 170.16 Comm. in tinadh ... do tochuilt,
iv 122.12 Comm. tochailt na mianna, v 474.32 Comm.
nocho necen a tachal, iv 208.8 Comm. in tSuca do t. (of
digging a channel), RC xviii 158.7. a adluice do t. doib ┐
a comradha do tocbáil doib, BCC 420.37. isin tres la tochalta
in chaisil, ALC i 224.20. in degarus do thochul, ML 164.19.
ro gabh for ledrad ┐ tochlad go ro ben an fiodh uile don t.
sin, BNnÉ 104.4. gunar fhacsat ... uaim ... gan tachailt,
Cog. 24.19. bile aonaigh ... do thesccadh iar n-a t. a tal-
mhain co na fremaibh, FM ii 714 4. ┐ iad ag t. fhréimhe
an chroinn, TSh. 578. gur orduigh a uaigh féin do th., 689.
tochal, tolladh, gonadh, cloichedh treachal, Eg. Gl. 572.

Concrete. excavation, cave: nach tocailt doronadh
roimpe, TBC 749 v.l. (nach class, text). ni dernta ríam
... tochalta bad comfudomanta friusin, CCath. 2510 v.l.
fochla leomhain .i. tochailt, uaimh, no poll leomhain, O'Cl.

egForm.p:
[io, iā (tochailt) engraved: an liric ... niamh-
ghreanta fadhairthe ar fod | téidleabhair tochailte tiomchol,
Studies 1923, 598 § 9.

ā, f. vn. of do-caith. act of using, consuming:
toroegha Partholon maighen shuthach do tochaitheamh
blatha, mesa, et murtoraidh Erenn innte, Leb. Gab. i 26.16.
go forcionn a thochaithmhe `until it was wasted,' Fl. Earls
50.25. Of food: ic tochathim bíd ┐ lenna, TBC 872. oc
tochatim na fledi, LU 8403 (FB 28). a tochaithium damsa,
RC xiv 412.18. o thairnic tóchaithem na fledi draidechta sin,
xxiii 410.7. ata fledh urrlum ... duit, ┐ tarra da tócaithem,
ZCP vi 48.7. corba hinbaid tócaithme doib, D iv 2, 75b40.
bainni a ngroighedh ┐ a lāirthech do thochaitim, Marco P.
36. iar tochaithimh na fessi dhoib, St. Ercuil 11. do
thochaithemh a prainne laithidhi
to eat their daily meal,
CCath. 5190. Of time: ria t. na cethra nuair fichit, Laws
v 504.27 Comm. iar t. ré a tairgille, O'Don. 434 (H.3.17,
col. 333). iar t. a bethad do, PH 4296. Of space: set
aíne cintuigh iar tocaithium secht muige, Laws ii 106.8
Comm.

eg.p: see *do-caith.

form.p:
o, m. (Perh. orig. n.; cf. is de ata Ath nGlona
ocus Tochar nGlona for M., RC v 201.9. and apl. tocra,
Laws v 94.12 Comm.) IGT Decl. § 11, § 104.

egForm.p:
causeway, passage: is ed dono and focal ro baí a mbelaib
an tsluaig o[c] denum an tochair ... `ní fes cuich les cuich
amles de thochar dar M.L.,' Ériu xii 178.21. rucad a chenn
co tochar C.B. ┐ forfācbad forsin nglaislicc ... hi medōn in
tochair (sic leg.), Arch. iii 225.18. conid aicci dorigned óen
thochur o Róim co Sliab nGarggan, Fél. 170.3. lodmor
īersin i tochor tāith, Aisl. MC 121.32. ar tocra ... ar cloca-
naib, Laws v 94.12 Comm. tochur tascartha, O'C. 723
(H.3.18, 346). 'sin Bothur etar Da Mag | tát sin tóchur
'na tatham, Met. Dinds. iv 286.40. mad dognīther lubair
... do drochtib ┐ tocraib, RC xii 430.8. a tochar Mōna
Connedha, xviii 298.29. in Gaillem do trāgudh ... ┐ tochar
mór eisc d'ḟaghail indti (of a heap of fish), 301.32. toccthar
iad chum tochair na mainistreach, ZCP x 18 n. 2. drochait
ocus tochair ocus sligedha, Cog. 140.2 v.l. do erged do
ar tochar in longpuirt, Ann. Conn. 1342.11. ionnsaighidh
meic R. tar t. siar, FM iii 232.4. do chúadar anonn thar
an t., Is. x 29. t. `a cawsey,' Eg. Gl. 589. Cf. ... co Lae co a
thachur co a glend, TBC² 3017 =co Laeg co a thochur,
TBC 4786.

form.p: Common in placenames; see Hog. Onom.

egForm.p:
In phr. crann tochartaig reel: crand tochartaigh
gl. gyrgyrium, Ir. Gl. 746. crann tocharthai no tochrais,
Laws i 152.21 Comm.

eg.p:
(a) pruritus, itch: tochus an chroicinn a
gcoitchinne, 23 K 42, 41.2. ar mbeith dá gclúasaibh líonta
do th., 2 Tim. iv 3. Cf. do léigetar sruthruathar sirtachais
tar slesaib na críche `a searching torrent of invasion,' Caithr.
Thoirdh. 44.27. Hence

(b) act of scratching: ni ro shaith
ionga ina fheoil ... ni derna riamh tochus, Mart. Don. 280.12.
ro fuair an damh ... da th. féin re fiodhlomán, Celt. Rev.
x 135.20.

egForm.p:
ā (tochas) scratches: [m]a tochasair an tsron
dod tingnib leath asdigh, 23 P 10 iii 26a3. cenguil lamha
in othuir fein no bid lamanda umpu do gnath, ┐ na tochuisidh
é, Rosa Ang. 316.3.

(-ó- ?) o, n. (but cf. ní biur do thóchaill, TBFr.² 132;
cia toichill berae, TBC² 961; decl. perh. influenced by
fidchell.) stake (in game of fidchell), usually in phr. berid
X t. Y X wins Y's stake, defeats him: madh tú beras mo
thoceall (tóchell, LU), Ériu xii 174.24. berar tochell M., 29.
berar tochell nEchada an lá sin. `Rucais mó tochell,' for
Eochaid, 180.3. damair a thoceall fo chédóir `he yielded
his stake,' 182.6. is [s]ainmuinter cach la fechtus bēus beiess
a tochell, Corm. Y 607. go rocurit fidhcelda na Temrach
dia saigidh-sium ┐ gou rug-som a toichell, RC xii 78 § 69.
Hence: toichill .i. buaidh, ut est, rucadh toichill Eathach
an lá sin, O'C. 1482 (H.3.18, 661). toichioll .i. buaidh,
O'Cl.

o, m. (but cf. gs. toichle infra). vn. of *do-foichell.
act of journeying; journey; farsin tochull fotu, Ml 82d10.
is gnáth do neoch íar tóchall | toidecht ina athbóthar,
ZCP vi 268 § 6. ni tháirsed dó tóichell ríchid | o tossuch
domain co a dered, LU 2479. itt é side húra doléicthe hi
Temair iar tóchul hÉirenn
after reaching Ireland, ZCP
viii 313.28. ní tairsidh dó tóchel an rīghthoighe `could
not finish the journey of,' RC xxviii 322 § 50. garit ó Chommur
co Delt | re tochell re techtairecht, Met. Dinds. iv 46.68.
adbar a toichill ocus a thechtairechta, MR 176.18. bean
toichle messenger, Leabh. ó Láimhsgr. vi 47.18. `toicheall'
gach n-imtheacht, Met. Gl. 10.1. tuachail .i. toicheall .i.
imtheacht, O'Cl. Cf. i n-a uile timchuairt ┐ tochelladh,
Fl. Earls 120.21.

form.p:
n, n. vn. of do-cing. Also tóichim, táichim, taichim,
tochéim. tóithim, táithim (tóichim táichim, v.l.), IGT
Decl. § 13 (66.12).

egForm.p:
(a) act of proceeding, marching; procession: trí luírg
didiu do Chormac oc tochím do C[h]rúachnaib, TBC² 7.
cēin bātar in slōig oc toichim Maighi Breg, 842. ragabsat
Ulaid ac tachim isin tulaig sin, TBC 5152. coro thafind
Saúl ass | la tochim a bag mbladbras, SR 6406. Toicheim
ina Buidhen, Anecd. ii 44.1. cid cáin lib in laechrad laind |
cengtai Emain iar tochaim, IT i 77.11. gia da betis for
a cind i n-oenbaile ... ┐ i n-oentochim, TBC 820. tiasad
i n-oenach no i toichim no i mbandáil, 2497. bá h-amra
in t. ron uicset in trén-fir, FB 7. ba ler di-si t. na sluag
uaithi, TTebe 2649. ba uallach leis indas in toichmi thuc
leis do déchain in banchuiri, TTr.² 498. ar thóchim do
thír fo thuind, Met. Dinds. iii 236.22. geiss di urchur na
geib greim | geiss di t. cen tairlim, iv 154.126. iar t. Thalten
fo thrí, 158.170. corba lan nem ┐ talam do'n tochim ┐ do'n
tarmcruthugud ro-fás ann `ascension,' PH 3089. gabh, a
mhic, mo mhúnadh-sa | ré dtoichim uaim ar eachtra,
Measgra D. 11.2. Hence means of travel, equipage: is
annsin do raid M.R. ra a dalta ... a thaichim conaire do
thabairt chuigi .i. a da dhamh ... ┐ a charpat, RC xliii
62.22.

eg.p:
(b) act of advancing (on); attacking: ba curata ...
in gné dorala forsin rig i tóchimm na catrach, Alex. 477.
ua dirim trethan na tonn ri tachim (toichestal v.l.) in tren-
sluaig sin, TTebe 1800. ré taicim na trenfer sin dochum
araile, 4451. re treisecht a tocimme, CCath. 4997. co tul
tarbda | co tachim thuinni, IT iii1 246.85. cend echda,
dubh fuirre fris nach gab tocaim
against which no attack
was successful, BB 495a31. (cf. Alex. 744). amail thoichim
tuindi fria tír, Lism.L. 3181. ruc taichim tren ... fo cath
na nAnmargach, Cog. 188.17.

(c) In phr. t. teglaig: tanic
... cona thóichim theghlaigh ┐ truim thinóil, ALC i 546.12.
tanic side cona toichim teglaig ina timchell, Ann. Conn.
1309.3

egForm.p:
(a) gait, appearance, manner: t. fossad n-álaind ...
issin chetna fuitherbe, LU 8252 (FB 20). delb a fir, dath a
ech, t. a charpait, LU 8588 (FB 44). t. ríghnaidi lé, BDD²
40. āilleam di flaithib domain a thothim itir ... bruth ┐
chruth ┐ errad, TBC² 3153. táchim slúaig barbardai, MU²
515. ba caem tra a reim seolta ┐ toichim a n-i mruma na
long sin, BB 428a32. atconairc rem ┐ toichim na laecraide,
414b21. ni raibi forsin domun ingen bid chaime tachim nó
tuarascbail inda si, RC xxiv 198.z. maith a ndelb ┐ a
táichim, Acall. 6230 v.l. (tuaruscbail, text). fochtus C.
toichim ┐ tuarusgbháil na buidhne san dorus de, Oss. ii
122.19. ba hinrigh toichim ┐ tuarascbáil an toichestal
tromshlóigh, Hugh Roe 300.26. Hence report (perh. in-
fluenced by tuarascbáil ?): damadh lor latsai uainsi tochmi
na mórgním-sa do reminnisin duit, CCath. 4073. fa toichim
na felli `on the report of the treachery,' ALC ii 454.25. ? and-
sain ragab Fergus ac tachim in tṡlúaig ac dula a Áth Mór
síar (ag feuchain, v.l.), TBC 6099.

eg.p:
(b) In phr. fon t.-sin in that manner: rancatar iarom
fon tachim sin co Cruachain, TFerbe 54. tanccatar fon
toc[h]im-sin ┐ fon tuaruscbáil, CCath. 5351. tainic roimhe
fón toichim sin, Buile S. 10 § 9. ro chinccsiot fón tóichim
sin do saighidh na slógh naile, FM v 1644.20. Ó Domhnaill
cona slogh occ triall fon toichim sin dia ionnsoighidh, Hugh
Roe 302.24. See also dochum.

egForm.p:
o,n., later m. vn. of *do-comairc. IGT Decl.
§ 11. act of wooing, courting: mug luide hua abracham
do thochmurc rebicae do ísác, Ml 127d3. dorigni t. inna
ecailse do Chríst, Tur. 48. luid do thochmorc nEmeiri,
TBC² 345. togla ocus tana ocus tochmarca, Laws i 46.4
Comm. t. nÉtaine dano so sís, LU 10789. ut est T. nEtaine,
Ériu xiii 65 § 53. sétig bad toga la C.C. do th. dó, LU 10162.
robudh th. tar lóegh (leg. lóech) mbeo sin
wooing a living
man's wife, ZCP xiii 173.5. roherbad fair mnái a dingmála
do thochmurc, 198.3. mo bethse oc t. na hingenee, iii 238.5.
is e dorigne t. Tuaide ingine Conaill, RC xxiv 274.z.
tearc atá a fachmharc na feisi | tachmharc na mná achd
meisi amháin, IGT Decl. ex. 451. bás Toirdhealbhaigh
is ég Airt | tug Éire gan fhear tochmhairc, L.Cl.A.Buidhe
x 34. T. do theacht for aithi tochmhairc fri F.
to elope,
ZCP xiii 171.17. ro gobh gach fer dib sin ac toga thochmairc
uaindi in lin ro bamar, TTebe 2030. imar a leannān ┐ a
thoga tochmhairc, ZCP xiii 166.7. ní thiucfaind adrut ┐
do thogha tochmhairc, Ériu iii 152.x. siur na mná—fa mana
uilc— | a-rís a rogha tochmhuirc, Aithd.D. 18.6. éirig-si
ar comairchi G. ... gan t. foreicne ort forced wooing, marriage,
Acall. 6464. gidh maith ben ní hedh is ferr | a tochmarc
tar a h-éigheann, Duan. Finn i 43.2. wedding: rothinoilsit
na sloigh as gach n-aird docum an tochmairc sin, St. Ercuil
558. marriage portion: cibed cuindces 'na tochmarc,
doberar do, BB 210a5 =tochra, Todd Nenn. 86.8. wooing,
pairing of animals: dece do caerca caeintlachta | nat
anat tochmairc tigerna, Leb. Gab. i 30.16. (.i.) nach anait
a naimsir a ttochmairc re a ttigerna da comairlegadh dhoip,
ib. n. 6.

eg.p: see *do-comairc.

egForm.p:
[o, m.] (tochmarc) wooing: nírbo chóem in t.,
Met. Dinds. iii 82.60.

ā, f. vn. of do-coisgedar. act of following:
issí inso in t., Ml 73a17. hi tochoisgim gl. in exsecutionem,
37a20. tochaisgim ł immaircedataid, 144d2. in carraic
icc a tocosscem cein ro-batar is-in díthrub, PH 5748. dia
tochoscem, 5751. toichoisceim inn uain neimhelnidhe,
Lism.L. 1123. Crist do intsamail ┐ do thocoisceim, 1132.

[iā,f.] (tochoisgem) following part, con-
tinuation: amal is follus sin o thochoscemtaige inna liachtan
fén, PH 7014.

form.p:
[i,m.] (tochoisgem) follower: t. gl. prose-
quutor, Ml 92a3.

egForm.p:
[ā, f.] (Cf. comaitecht) accompaniment: a
canas in triar anechtar iss ed chanas na tri sacairt ar medon,
i t. fo chutruma fríu, Misc. Ascoli 376 § 27.

eg.p: see do-comlai.

egForm.p:
u, m. vn. of do-comlai. act of proceeding,
advancing: ba handso cach pēin forsnaib anmandaib .i.
tochumlud ō ghnūis Dē `faring forth,' Ériu ii 142.y. a
cētna tochumluth ō Emain co hIrard Cuilleand, TBC² 3062.
tochomlud procedure (gl. luminis lunaris circuitus ac redin-
tigratio), Vien. Bed. 24. mad ferr lat tomadmond ocus
fisi ... ocus sluagid ocus tochomladha, Anec. ii 45.z. tochom-
ladh Parthalain co Herinn, tochomladh Fer mBolg co
Herinn, 46.9. cethraime vii cumala i tocomla fris ┐ esce
fris tocomla, no frith suide, O'C. 2114 (H.4.22, 79a) =
cethraime secht cumal hi tocomluth fris co maigin in echta,
O'Don. 865 (H.3.17 col. 618). baí acc tocomhladh co
h-ionmall ina dheadhaidh, FM vi 2276.8. tocomhladh .i.
ceimniughadh, O'Cl. oc a damnad, oc a tocamlad `exercis-
ing,' Laws v 490.2 Comm.

[o, m.] (to + comrac) assembly: óenach, ocus
dal do chundriug, ocus tochomrac do chrích, Críth Gabl.
502. ma teccmai lith laithe no dail no thocomracc tuaithe,
Laws v 396.21, 398.10. See comrac.

form.p:
[ā, f.] vn. of *to-com-reth- (to-n-comrit, Wb
14b23 (a prima manu), Ped. ii 598, following Zimmer's
reading; but toncomra, Thes.).

eg.p:
weariness, vexation: ropo t. linn buid i mbethu gl.
ita ut tederet nos etiam vivere, Wb 14b24. ba t. la hUltu
a n-aicsiu oc collud a n-hírend, LU 10561 = ba saeth la
h-Ulltaib, Eg. o shunn ro-marbad a mac | dor'arbrad
fo th., SR 6922. co fessabair bith fo smacht | cen truaigi,
cen t. (sic leg. —ac, text), 1090. huair dorochair dib a tlacht |
roslín truaigi is tocomracht (sic leg. —ac, text.), 1354. cang-
nib gleraib, gloraib cacht | ardib trenaib tochomracht
(sic leg. —ac, text), 4570. ba tochombracht, ba galár
menman ... lais, Hugh Roe 12.15.

form.p:
g (tochomracht) is weary: no tochum-
rachtaiged gl. tedebatt, Ml 127c13.

egForm.p:
io, n. vn. of do-cren. Used like tinnscra; see
Thurneysen. in Stud. in E. Ir. Law, 121 f. payment made by
bridegroom to bride or bride's father: is maith sin, for a hathair,
┐ faemaid amlaid sin tarceann t. dingbala di, RC xxiv 274.2.
ro naiscedh do inn ingen iardain ┐ ro naisced t. na hingine
fair-seom, 10. roraid nā faidfed fri Find, acht mina thuctha
dí in t. nochuindigfed fair, ZCP i 458.y. luid iarum in ingen
do Find ... ┐ icaid Find .vii. cumola 'na tocra, xiii 280.9.
rogell t. mór di, BColm. 92.1. rochuinigh īarum an ben
a t., 2. cidbe cunges 'na t. (tochmarc, v.l.) do-berthar di
(dó, v.l.), Lebar Bretnach § 30. do rad gradh da siuir, co
ro triall a breth gan tocra, Todd Nenn. 120.10. maithbet
a tinnsccra ┐ a t. duib, ML 160.15. is di tugad Sliab Senaig
... ina t., BB 376b51. laigid giallna for t., laigid t. for
iaraig, O'C. 1868 (23 P 3, 20c). ? To this: co mbitis ... oc
a t. (? leg. tochmarc), LU 3162. t. .i. coibhche, O'Cl.

o, ā (tochur) warlike, contentious:
nar t. fri truagaib, Gorm. Sept. 10. triur tennmín nar
tac[h]rach (.i. nar deabhtach), July 1. Tid (Tydeus) trom
trentachrach mac Oenís, TTebe 345. in cu acgarb ...
treitelltachrach trencendach Ceirbeir, 600.

eg.p: see do-cuirethar.

egForm.p:
u, m. vn. of do-crecha. contrivance, plot:
nach t. .i. nícon fel ní dugáitha adi gl. secreta molitio, Ml
55c13. ón t. gl. molimine, 19a9. inna tochrechthu gl.
bellorum machinas, 26d4. tóchrechad gl. molimen, Sg. 54a9.

[o, m] act of winding (yarn): crand tocharthai no
tochrais, Laws i 152.21 Comm. is t. im oibil .i. tarcud febe
imm olc (sic leg.) fochná, O'Mulc. 758. ? no dos-díngaib
gan t. | amal atchi cendfochrus, Auraic. 2109.

vn. formation from do-coissig. act of maintain-
ing: tabar ascid dún dī di búaib ... ár atá ecen mor fornd
tochsaígid in tslúaig dolluid lind for longais, LU 1563
(TBFlidais).

eg.p: See taiscid, toischid.

form.p:
[ā,f.] = techt, vn. of téit, later of do-téit, do-icc (see
dul, tiachtu, tíchtu, techt), IGT Decl. § 95. teacht, tocht,
teachta, tochta, toigheacht .c. uili, IGT Verbs § 5.

eg.p:
(a) act of going: atib dig re t. ar fecht, Ir. Review
1912, 248 § 7. coro thimart, cota mart | dó thochta i tír
n-Egept, SR 3072. oc t. ind, oc tuidecht ass, Met. Dinds.
iii 10.103. is failid limsa ... t. saor docum bais amail teigim,
CCath. 6066. iarsindi trá na tárraid in mac óc a aite ria t.
issin fidbaid, TTr. 232. ua hecal ... les-seom t. isin cathraig,
TTebe 615. is adlaic linni tochta i mbáig Laigen, RC xiii
124.5. adbert re Cond t. isin dabhaigh da fhothrugadh,
Ériu iii 156.z. denaidh si ... t. docum neimhe, MS. Mat.
530.35. gá córughadh budh cóir orum | ní fhedar ré tt.
tar tuinn, Sc. G. St. iv 62 § 13. do chorp a naomh Muire
anonn | ar dt. d'aon-uidhe is t'anam, Dán Dé xv 34. maoith
chroidhe, gé'r chéim diadha | t. i dtíribh imchiana, Measgra
D. 49.10. can t. re gaith no ar feanfud, Cog. 182.22. do
raidh ris t. go hionadh a eiseirge, BNnÉ 264.9.

(b) act of
dying: bidh olc dígeann bhías duit de | t. fo dheoidh gan
aithrighe, Buile Ṡ. 144.17.

(c) With foll. gen. (correspond-
ing to the transitive use of téit, q.v.): gar bec re t. in t[s]lúa-
gaid, Ir. Review 1912, 248 § 6.

II act of coming: is amlaid lēicfimid uaind tú, ar chom-
airce rīgraidhe Ērenn uile ... 'mud t. slān cugainde dorisi,
Ériu iii 158.28. atat ag t. anosa diar ngrísad, FDG 314.
ar dt. d'iomarbháigh iomána, L. Cl. A. Buidhe 12. 4. ní
thréigfe tú ar dt. a-nonn | Inis Fáil na bhfiodh gcnódhonn,
Measgra D. 52.29. truagh do thosach a dhuine | ar dt. i
dtruaill talmhuidhe, A. Ó Dálaigh, xli 1. red th. i dtionól
an luain, DDána 51.4. ballchaomh ód thochta gach teach |
a lannchraobh chorcra, a chláirsioch, Studies 1923, 275 § 14.
Fir Muighi, trá, ar t. ón cath, Ériu iv 226 § 54. ? To this:
a Thomáis, a th. meanmnach, Dánta Gr.² 41.69. With
gen.: sinni ba toisciu 'ca th. `at coming to it,' RC vii
296.z.

form.p: III With prepp. and adverbs in special idioms.

eg.p:
(a) with
ar, etc.: bhar dt. ar ceal is cinnte departure, death, Dán
Dé xxv 20 = TSh. 2693.

(b) with do, etc.: cid dia tucais
form tocht do laim `go to communion,' BNnÉ 300.z.

(c) with
fo: tiocfa rú gan t. fa a thoil obeying, PBocht 25.2.

(d) with
fri: bráthair bocht as daingean dúnn | is aingeal gan
t. re a thréan `irresistible,' PBocht 13.50.

(e) with i,
etc.: gur thaiséntar t. 'na cceann | aisécthar olc na
hEireann `opposition,' Studies 1919, 257 § 14. am écen-sa
t. i n-herus inalta F., TBC 556. bec in luach ar t. is tech,
Arch. iii 240 § 35. mar shlighe dar dtochta is-teagh | tre
chridhe gcorcra an Choimdheadh, DDána 54.22. atá i
ndán dó go dtiocfa | fear fhuaslaicthe a airmearta | budh
éigin trá a th. asteagh | lá éigin ar Ghort nGaoidheal
assume
kingship, TD 1.9.
(f) with tar.

(i) act of going beyond,
passing: an gort 'ga leithchinead leis | feithfidhear gan
t. thairis, DDána 96.22.

(ii) act of mentioning, discussing:
siol Colgain mic Mughroin moir | t. tairsu is oirches d'eicsibh,
LL 394.29.

(g) with tre: bocht ar dteannta ón dtriur | a
mbeadhgtha ag t. tríom, Studies 1931, 262.14.

form.p: [u, m.] See also socht, sost, tost.

egForm.p:
(a) silence:
ro mhuidh t. mór orrosumh uime sin, Acall. 34. a-nocht
gan mhoirn gan mheadhair | doirbh an t. 'nar thuiteabhair,
Measgra D. 56.56. gidh mé as toirsighe dá th., DDána
86.41. luighidh t. ar an fhiach | i measg na n-éan gcoimh-
thigheach, Dánfhocail 204. Usually in phr. i t. silent:
dobhádus selat im th., ZCP viii 220 § 30. is mairg nách
ad th. do bhís, KMMisc. 49.26. bi it t., Buile S. 58.1.
congaibh bhós do bhéal na th., Dánta Gr.² 39.33. cóir
dhamh ó nach damhann ceart | an chalann do char [sic
leg.] na t. `to silence,' Dán Dé ix 11. ní chuirfe leo mise
im th., Content. xiv 35. an Chóir gé chuire 'n-a t., DDána
3.28. ag breith breithe, eter beth a t. ┐ ag labhra, BNnÉ
123.11.

(b) inactivity, cessation: imairecc cen imdeghail
cin t. cen toirisim, St. Ercuil 318. nach féadadh féin t. do
chur ar a chaoi, TSh. 5985. o chaoi gan t., Oss. v 134.12.
da roibh t. na fola mista ar mnaib si igitur deficiant mens-
trua, Ir. Texts v 16.17. nisi menstrua defecerint ... .i.
muna mbia t. fola misda orra, 23 K 42, 95.2. In phr. i t.
inactive: damad derb leis dul go grod | acht dobiadh sē
'na t., | nī dingnadh egna nā modh | ar egla a dul don
shaeghul, ZCP vii 301 § 4. ní id th. a-taoi gá thuilleamh,
Aithd.D. 11.21. ar gcúl do chuadar a bríogha | do bhí na
t., truagh an léan, PBocht 9.34.

eg.p:
(c) oppression, grief:
créad an t. so ar scoltaibh éigse ?, ITS iiia 136.5. do ghlac
racht ┐ t. aigne é, go nár fhéad labhairt feadh uaire, PCT
137.

egForm.p:
[u, m.] piece, portion: rannais D. assil tshalli hi
cóic tóchtaib, Thr. Hom. 60.2. dorat B. di in cóiced t. ar
throcaire, 3. for dá bairgin do chruithnecht ┐ for th. sen-
saille, Aisl. MC 9.20. doberar a théig dó ┐ oslaicis hí,
co m-ben dí bairgin ... essi la t. senshoilli, 23.11. dogni
tochtu dib ┐ dobeir toocht sen-shaille etir cech da toocht
ursaille, ┐ toocht ursaille etir cech da toocht sensaille,
117.25. go mbértais na tochta fola ┐ feóla ... in nélaib,
TBC 3616. cach t. ┐ gach thinmi do benadh cách díb ... do
shlindenaibh a chéle, 3705 v.l. rocenglad tocht senshailli
┐ mesair senbrogoitti isin mbert lūachra, ZCP iii 35.21
= ceangultar trath socht saille le measair brogoide isin furt
luachra, Études Celt. ii 298.22. mar tochta do shliseoig
no do chleiti, Irish Texts v 84.5. tocht .i. spólla. trí tochta
.i. tri spólla, O'Cl. ? slis comfat tocht troimfer (? leg.
troim-fir), Dinds. § 42. ? usga, tuis, boladh, t., Eg. Gl.
615.

eg.p: see tongaid.
see tophta.

egForm.p:
o, m. (1 tochta) sworn witness: cach t. .i. toingid
itir fír ... ┐ gae, O'C. 469 (H.3.18, 246). cach tochtaig .i.
toingis fair co indligthech, O'C. 453 (H.3.18, 242a).

o, ā (2 tocht) silent: air nirb áil léo labairt
o maith, fobith comad t., Aisl. Tund. 114.14. ná bíodh do
chédfadha go huallach ná go hédtróm acht go tromdha t.,
Mac Aingil 293.14.

[u, m.] (tócht) act of hewing in pieces: bar slaide
┐ bar slechtad for t. ┐ bar tinmi, TBC 5857.

ā (2 tocht) is silent, becomes silent: ro thocht an
sruth ┐ ro chosg eargla an ath, RC xi 325.3. tochtaitt
iarom, xiii 6.13. do tocht ar Tid aga faigsin, TTebe 918.

o, ā (2 tocht) taciturn: bid an tothar t. ┐ leisge
gluasachta air, Rosa Ang. 228.1. Cf. tochtach.

o, ā (2 tocht) silent: bí a gCroídhe t., támhach,
Donl. 468.15.

eg.p: see 1, 2 do-cuirethar.

form.p: [u, m.] vn. of 2 do-cuirethar.

eg.p:
(a) act of inviting,
invitation: is indarbae demnae | is t. aingel, Fél. Ep. 212.
tri indarba n-anfis, tri thochurud fis, ZCP xii 363.33. de
thochuriud (sic leg.) gente i n-iris, Hib. Min. 30.z. bái oca
tócuriud din tsíd, LU 3619 (SC 31). olc duit ... rí Herenn
do thocoiriud co trichait ríg imbi cen bith ria mbeolu oc
airiuc thuili dóib, ZCP iii 7 § 25. ni ba tochuiriuth
droch-carat det-si, IT i 120.26. ni h-ail dam iarom toch-
uiredh ind fhiallaich sin, LL 400b32. dochuaid da thocuriud
co Emain, TBC 959. atgeoin fri fochmarc fuired | in
tochmarc, in tochuired, Met. Dinds. iii 224.12. de frithai-
leam a tochuirthe i llō brātha o mac an athar nemdai hi
flaith a athar, ZCP xii 367.30 = RC xlvi 233.23. a tiger-
nadhu do thochuiriudh chuici do shaighidh na fleidhe,
ZCP xi 61.4. oc a tócuired chuice do'n fhlaith nemda, PH
3643. ac tochuiredh na nGregach as gach aird, St. Ercuil
141. ar ni saig a tarr-fine fine cen tocuirid, Laws v 456.23.
tocuirid leibind
invitation to threshing-floor (=
permission
to glean), 486.14. tocuiread loiste, 17. dia ttochuiredh
chuige ar a suipēr, Fl. Earls 106.10. du-s-riacht tochuiredh
ar na maithibsin chom an espairt, 174.20.

(b) act of summon-
ing: tegur uada do tocuiredh Fechín, RC xii 332.4. ro
fhaid-seom a mac co Feradach ... i crích n-Alban dia thó-
curiud i-rríge ṅHērenn, ZCP xii 274.10. Flaithbheartach
do thochuireadh mhurchobhlaigh do Dail Riata do chum
nEireann, FM i 326.7. Cf. ro cuir ... ri Affraici uathaichi
marcsluaigh do celgadh Curio ┐ da thochuriudh asa long-
phort docum in tsloigh moir ro innill for a cind
to entice him,
CCath. 3090.

form.p:
o, m. vn. of 1 do-cuirethar. Later also tachar,
tochar, IGT Decl. § 17.

eg.p:
(a) act of putting: dath firinne do thochur taraise, Ml
28c12. aní ba buthi ar thuus do thochur fo diud, 29a8. mo
brogad for mara múr | mu c[h]úl do t[h]ochar frim éol, ZCP
x 45.16. doridnacht dam ón ríg rél | mo sóg do thachar i
cé[i]n `that my happiness should be prolonged,' Ériu iv 158.19.
In phr. t. tar cenn overturn, upset: t. tar cend, Laws iv
314.7. cucligi in talman occa th. dar aird ┐ dar cenn `being
turned up and over,' Ériu ii 138 § 137. ad-comaicc a erball
do th. in beatha tar a cheann, BDD² 503.

(b) legal what
is thrown on shore; jetsam: diles t. do fir puirt, Laws iii
424.13. tochar srotha, O'Don. 844 (H.3.17 col. 602). curab
é in tainmrainde sin ícaidh dona secht cumalaib atá ina
nemtochur, O'Don. 1605 (H.5.15, 11b). Also (perh. through
confusion with tacar, q.v.): im chorus puirt i naimseraib
tochuir, Laws i 124.1. .i. a tocur don tig ocus hi tirim,
132.3 Comm. tochar puirt .i. mona, Laws v 474.6, 33.

(c) act of throwing, sending: atbert ... na h-úbla do
tachor chuice, Aisl. MC 5.22. iar tochar na set sin suas,
Anecd. ii 57.17. ascolt ocus tinorgna | ocus t. blath atbeir,
Hib. Min. 40.27. ara tachur i noen charcair, Rawl. 74a22.

(a) act of happening: tascar .i. tecmaisin no t. no
tachar, O'Dav. 1501. nir' saoil neach a t. mar dorala,
CCath. 3660. talam torthech, barca do thochor i port,
Tec. Corm. i 25. ecmaic tra araile fer cristaige do muntir
Ierusalem do thachur isin sinagoig moir, PH 47. triar
ocloech do Corca Duibne do dul co Roim dia nailithri ┐
a tochar co hardepscop na R., RC xlvi 231.6. rogab ar
cell coscur do thocur do for Aenias `he conceived that a
victory over A. had fallen to him,' Aen. 2586.

(b) act of
journeying (to), meeting: ria t. ma náem `before meeting
my saint,' PRIA xix 536 § 28. i ré déidenach do bhethad |
gléideired do thachair, SG 353.9. ó tá im fochair gnúis
don ghrianfhuil | túis ár dtochair trialluidh sinn, Ó Bruad.
iii 200 §ii. a thochar gus an maighin as arg habhsat a
shinsir nert ...ar Erinn, FM vi 2292.y.

(a) t. fri act of opposing, fighting: ni hé ar cara
budh ail lind do thachar riu, Acall. 6734. leasc dho tachar
tul i tul | frisin eaclais roní dlugh, SG 70.19. mairg d'Ultaib
... tachar friom-sa fó'n cuchtair, 321.20. scath an torathair
ag tachur ris, TTebe 1205. nír tarbha tachar risna trein-
fheruibh, Caithr. CC § 22 (13.12). Hence

(b) act of fighting:
is olc tachar flatha | re fatha gan chin `to oppose a prince,'
Fianaig. 84.11. rothuit ag tachor fan tír, Met. Dinds.
iv 252.23. do thochar i naghaidh an madhma sin, FM iv
1120.22. atái ar thí thachair go trom, SG 26.42.

(c) battle,
fight: tachar .i. deabhaidh no comhrac, O'Cl. athcha lonna,
lethra tromma | tochar ferga, ZCP viii 196 § 18. ad-agur
sa tachur daib, 549.17. ata tachar fria ar muinndtir, Anecd.
i 22.5. mo thachar fria Mumnechaib, Lism.L. 3289. t.
meinic, troid cen fhuirech, BNnÉ 99 § 11. béraidh búaidh
i ngach tachar, 259 § 218. bos tláith na dtachar n-édtláth,
Studies 1921, 418 § 9. fir mharbha d'athghuin san ágh |
fadhbha a ttachruibh do thionál, IGT Decl. ex. 759. long
gan tlás i dtachar arm, Measgra D. 48.21.

(d) act of attack-
ing; attack: na fúatha ... do tachor cuccom `the spectres
attacked me,' RC xxvii 272.6. tachur longphuirt dudénum i
connacta, O'Gr. Cat. 7.11. With do-beir: co tuc M. tacur
ocus cor marbad leis U., Cog. 148.5. ni thucc debaid na
tachar doib, Ann. Conn. 1230.7. drong do muintir h.
Domnaill do tabairt tochuir don tsluag, 1398.2.

(e) con-
tention, quarrelling, strife: aenta gan tachor, BNnÉ 78 §
150. lān da thachur as d'ḟeirg, Arch. iii 237 § 17. is truagh
dona hEireannchaib an mí-bhés dóibh tachur eturra féin,
TFrag. 140.13. tochar dorala dam arāir fri múnntir Cor-
ccaige, Aisl. MC 57.5. i t. risna clerchib, LL 150a8. in
rigan ecnaid óg fhial | t. ria noco deg-ciall, LL 150a11.

egForm.p:
(f) gs. as adj. warlike: accmaing tochair, CCath. 5499.
a los céimeann dteann dtachair | geall Éireann ag Ulltach-
aibh, Content. xxx § 30. lamanda tarbda tachair `boxing-
gloves,' TTebe 2504. clár óir fá fhoirinn tachair
set of
chessmen?, 23 G 24, 262. or ba hiad sin a lucht ... tachair
┐ troda, Ériu viii 138.2. Fland in tochuir, Arch. Hib. ii
84 § 33. inniset do ríg in tochair | mar dorochair Cumascach,
SG 373.36.

eg.p:
Compd. borb fierce in battle: mac tacharborb Toirr-
dhealbhaigh, FM iv 694.4.

form.p: u, m. (Cf. 1 toich) Also tothchas.

egForm.p:
(a)possessions,
property: cona t. techta, Laws i 40.18 eneclann do cach
fo t., 42.27 Comm. briugu leitech, diablad tochusa la suidiu,
v 78.7. is amlaid comruinter in eniclann, a leth ar scath
tochusa ┐ a leth ar scath indracuis, Laws 34.12 Comm.
is as t. miter cach la Feine, .i. tir ocus innille ┐ ceilib ...
O'C. 2219 (Eg. 88 fo. 16). mas do cert-tochus, Laws v
32.21 Comm. mas d'forcraid tochusa, 24 Comm. t. etars-
carthach `separable property,' iii 108.2. duine risi nem-
etarscartha a tochusa, O'C. 344 (H.3.18, 191b). t. is mesa
fil hi senchus annso, tochuis dair ┐ dochraite, O'C. 226 (H.3.18,
121). mase an sinsior as mo tothchus, bi tighearnas aige,
MS. Mat. 583.12. nach biadh i ttothchusaibh, 18. righi
na airechus na feibh thochusa, Lism. L. 2368. míastar
cách iar n-a th., Tec. Corm. § 6.43. abair. . .réir condnaige
co tardor | duit o t. mo thire, RC xx 142.22. in fil occatsa
... tothchus críchi no ferainn dilis, Moling 2. Digais 'na
sléib mar atchlos; | fail and iar céin a tothchos, Met. Dinds.
iii 90.42. Hence

eg.p:
(b) qualification: caide tochas sgel cach
ae dib so? secht caegait sgél la hollamain ..., O'Don. 980
(H.3.17, col. 779). graid eclasa ... ima naos ┐ im a ninn-
rucus ┐ ima t. leighinn, O'Don. 681 (H.3.17, col. 499). im sechtmad
lóig a einig cech áin iar na grad ┐ iarna th. do thabairt dia
ollamuin, LL 187b6. ni am fir febaib .i. ni h-anacol do
neoch aḟirinni nach a th., 188b6. gabais Conchobur righi
n-Ulad iarsin ar thochus a máthar ┐ a athar `in right of
his mother and his father,' RC vi 178.131. gabais ... righi in
choicid a t. a mathar ocus tria dan ┐ fisidecht a athar,
YBL 180a33.

? ní t. don bith .i. nimmatudchaid for bith ché gairdde
a aimsire `no increase,' ACC 126.

egForm.p:
i (tóchustal) assembles, musters: ro thochastail
... Etiocles ... na Tiauanda, TTebe 1593. gur thinóil ocus
gur tochastail óg-riograidh Alban, MR 110.9.

o, m. (but cf. Tochustal nUlad, Anecd. ii 43.y.).
Also tóicheastal, tóchossal, etc. Act of assembling, muster-
ing; assembly, muster: ra ráid riss techt do thinol ┐ do
thochustul Ulad, TBC 4761. do choid ... in A. do tochustal
slog i tír I., LB 150b36. faídis techta fan cúiced do tho-
chostul lochta in chóicid, MU² 190. flead do th. agud ┐
fir Erenn do t[h]abairt dia caithim, FDG 65. síl Ádhaim
anfhoclaig | adhbal an toichestal, ZCP viii 210.4. tiucfad
fan toic[h]istal, 11. Diarmuid Mac Murchadha ... iar
toichestal Gall, RC xviii 281.24. da tinōl ┐ da toigistal a
n-aigid na n-allmurach, ZCP xiii 237.12. tochestol Ulad,
TBC 4765. conna rucad [a] burach immach etir .i. co tairsed
tóchustul Ulad, RC xviii 54.23. fo thogairm in thochustail
sin na Romanach, LB 154a12. comhtocbail cogaid etar
cardiu, tochastal tuath n-eachtrand, CCath. 1043. co
tancatar i tocustal in morcatha, 3252. dorigned tinol ┐
toichestal, Acall. 5070. gan mórān toic[h]iostail do dhēa-
namh cuige, Feis TC 1873. día tangadar F. a tochosal
chatha M.T., Met. Dinds. iv 282.2. ba hann ceda-imraidhedh
tochestol chatha M.T., 302.3. tinol a toithistul do denam,
RC xxix 6 § 2. cinnid sluaighte ar séan gcneadh | tóich-
easdal ceithre gcóigeadh, Content. xxx § 31. ó thóicheastal
throid-mhear thinneasnach na tréan-fhoghla soin, TSh.
6643. don toigheasdal sluaigh, Rel. Celt. ii 180.25. Troops,
army: rocuir [Lughaidh] toghairm ┐ tionól for a thoichestal,
ZCP xiv 249.2. tionōiledh ... dā Corca mo Dhruadh līon
a ttoicestail co Luimnech, 267.7. ot cualatar ... gaill in
tochastul sin cucu, Cog. 150.15. Flaithbeartach ... cona
toichestal do beith illongport isin ccorann, FM iii 88.3.
o d chualaidh mac U. ... an toichestail slóigh lán mhóir sin
do beith acc an president, v 1644.5. Iábin ... lena toith-
eastal, Judges iv 7.

form.p: o, ā (tóchustal)

eg.p:
(a) mustered, mobilised: triallait
... go tromtairpthech tóchestalach, Caithr. Thoirdh. 8.24.
triath na dtrodán dtóicheastlach, O'Bruad. iii 80.4.

(b)
proud, arrogant: ag triall go tóicheastalach i nglór-réim,
TSh. 472. clanna tréna ... tóigheasdalach, Rel. Celt. ii
260.20.

form.p: [io,n.] vn. of tocraid. See tacra.

eg.p:
(a) act of seeking,
a way: araill oc saint ocus oc t. isin uaim, Anec. ii 56.13.
atát cóic bíasta ... i fudomnaib iffirn oc tochra (togra,
toccrai, v.ll.) forsin talmain co dóine, Ériu ii 196 § 11. da
madh t. go Temraig | bud mían le mac Torrdhelbaig, Ir.
Texts ii 37 § 13. batur manuigh ac togra gu R., Lism. L.
2680.

(b) act of desiring; desire: tainic t. dó ... dula do
Róimh, Lism. L. 2567. god thogra do Thoigh na nGiall,
Aithd.D. 5.12. gach tuath ... a-tá ag togra a gléimheadhóin,
7.13. nach dlegur ní noch do toigeorad si do luagh 'na
fiaghnuse gan a tabairt di oir muna fagha si é tureis a
togurtha is cus mhillti da toirrcheas é, Ir. Texts v 34.14.
do reir thógra a chroidhe, 2 Cor. ix 7.

(c) act of attempting:
lin dirimhe ... di vhestibh vathmara examla, accus síad
for denmniv et dasacht ag togro fordivclvime ṅa n-anmonn
ttrúag, Aisl. Tund. 100.2 = ag togra na n-anmanṅ ṁbocht
do shlugud, 126.8. fonn dúthaigh Duach Ġalaigh | a-tá
ag togra a chomhthabhaigh, Aithd. D. 7.6. don tslógh ní
tráth do thogra | clódh ogla ar áth dá n-abra, RC xlix
174 § 36.

Earlier tocair; apparently from a compd. of gair—,
but no deuterotonic forms are attested. (Except perh.
adchíu do fócrat far mná | a ngnúis tarsna ergala | adchíu
far rígna in móir | ni toccair don imforráin, LU 6582.
do fógrador (sic leg.) a cáirde í dosguilt, Ir. Monthly liv
699.13).

(a) desires to go, seeks a way: ni tocair (toccair, LU 6585)
dond nimforrāin, TBC² 2063 = na hérig, TBC 2769. tocair
assa cháthair fein | i cáthir comaitech, ZCP xviii 92.6.
co tocraitís asa tíribh do décsain ┐ do tháidbrivd crotha
H., TTr.² 1091. nách mothaig ... urchóit ... na tened thog-
ras, PH 7732. dia thig ní rothocair-sium, Met. Dinds.
iv 90.15. na moigi co tren dothocair | scel dar goiri obair
ann, iii 436.7. fear nar thogair (: cogaidh) [an] teagh
comhóil, PBocht 8.32. gurob i neascoid is fearr acu .i.
a[n] neascóid togras amach ar lethni ┐ ar cumga,
23 P 10 i, 10a36. tic geg ele on cuslinn darub ainm concaua
┐ on sgairt ... suas togras ┐ tet geg dib cum na laime deisi,
23 F 19, 20a59. Cf. is tairrsib nach togairther, MR 144.16.
is tairrsi rothogairset, 316.9.

(b) desires: gibe roinn thuigeoraid do thabairt fair,
BNnÉ 257.29 v.l. (thoileochait, text). gach ben do thoig-
eoradh fer isin tír sin do bidh aigi, St. Ercuil 1103. da
mbeireadh, mar nac béradh | breith don taoibh da ttuigérad,
3 C 12, 3.2. da ndeach sé ar uaisle énar | fuair se an té do
toigérad, 54.8. tig díom ma thograim coimhmeas, Content.
xiv 31. gidh bé thoigeorus sgríobhadh go fóirleathan
líonmhar ar Eirinn, O'Gr. Cat. 45.32. tograid siat gan
toirrces do tecmail doib co brach le meid a pene, Irish
Texts v 36.8. tiucfaidh se chúghatsa ┐ togaróig dul chum
na Rómha, ITS xvi 74.19. fionnar ó a chodladh 'n-a curp |
dá dtogradh, d'iomad ar n-olc | go ndiongna rí an chruinne
ceart, DDána 3.14. gibé aithrigheach do thaigeóradh
xiv 31. gidh bé thoigeorus sgríobhadh go fóirleathan
buaidh do breith ar Timoteus, Eochairsg. 92.5. an tan
do thogair dul d'á thigh do leigheas a buachalla, 99.25.
an tan do thogradh nísa mhó do chodladh do dhéanamh,
Keat. iii 1123. achd ag an mac agus an té dá dtoigheóra
an mac a nochdughadh, Luke x 22. do shiubhaltá mar
a dtogarthá féin, John xxi 18. seachnadh an liaigh an
t-adhbar do toghairm isin sl[i]ghi nach togrand an nádúir
a innarbad, 23 P 10 i, 23a15.

(c) chooses: do cuiredh deichneabhar ar coitcheann
Senáin, ┐ a mhéid do toccratar féin arin ccomharba, ZCP
x 1813. resin mbrághaid do bhí i láimh | do thogair geall
do ghabháil, DDána 7.12. nach deacra an taom do thogras,
Aithd.D. 40.6. do thograbhairsi ar feadh tamaill gáird-
eachus do dhéunamh ann a sholus, John v 35. mac Donn-
chadha nár thogair bheith breoidhte, Ó Bruad. ii 224.4.

(d) resolves: fer ionaid Pettair is Poil. ... dul gan toirnemh
do thoccair | da n-oirdnedh 'na n-epscopaibh, BNnÉ 283.19.
is ann sin do togair A. imthecht, St. Ercuil 1090. do thogair
Policornus inghean álainn aontumha d'éigniughadh, Keat.
ii 1698. do thogradar a marbhadh do láthair, 2946. ar
mbeith ar eachtra dhóibh, tograid ... triall dá ndúthaigh,
TSh. 9615.

egForm.p:
(e) tries, attempts: gia toghraid comaroa do, Laws v
428.3. .i. cia triallait comarba a tindtu, 13 Comm. nir
thairgset no nir togairset cairde no siothcain, Leb. Gab.
156 n. 6. ceitri cuarta ro thogair Mure dul anairdi isin
strapa, Études Celt. i 82.27. ro thoguir dul astegh isin
sépél ┐ nír fhét dul ann, 84.24. do thogair dá bhrígh sin an
dobhran do mharbhadh, BNnÉ 162.30. an tan do thogair
Absolon a athair do dhíbirt, TSh. 994. agus do thairgeas
(.i. thogras) ... a béasa-san do leanmhuin `endeavour,' Donl.
388.26.

form.p: Vn. tocra.

egForm.p:
o, (m.) vn. of *do-accráidi. Later tocrádh, tacrádh,
tochradh, tachrádh, IGT Decl. § 11 (54.4.) Act of annoying,
vexing, vexation: tacráth gl. exacerbatione (sic leg.), Wb
33a10. ar ba tocrad do-side nomen regis, Goid. 66.7. co
tartad dilgud dó don toccrad tucc fair, RC ii 382.y. combu
hé fochan a báis tacrád do P., Trip. 228.23. arin tocrad
dorat S. for P., 394.20. ni tocrad (tocrád, LU) dam dino
int aitheach mattud [do] gl[i]eid frisin coin moir, TBC²
1228. amal leoman ... íarna th. fo chvilenaib, TTr.² 728.
dia m-beth ar shluaghaib bán m-bán | nech no beith icco-
tócrad, IT i 124.4. arnabad tocrad do denam dia chind,
Ériu xii 144.11. ni cumgaim a fhaisneis ... in nech is tacradh
lim a scaradh frim, D iv 2, 41va 21. do brondad cacha bíd
... bus tol dot' chorp ocus nā ba t. dot anmain, Aisl.
MC 77.7. ni do tocrad duíb si em ... do-gnisa so ┐ de con-
bleacht frit, ZCP xiii 280.21. mun badh tac[h]rād, a Dē,
duīt, | atberainn astan cen at, vi 263.30. men bad tacrad
latt a rí | co ndernaind ni bud maith latt, LL 374c24. is
t. re triathaib a tanmesc, MR 192.10. ni dernad tocradh
Dé ann, Lism. L. 2199. dus in raibi dib nech dia bud tocrad
cogad fri Grecu, BB 423a50. lomnocht dodheachaidh sé
sonn | dom thochradh is dom thafonn, Buile Ṡ. 8.14. na
bí ag mo tocrádh ni as sía, 44.14. comlanus cecha uilc ┐
cech toccraid, PH 4344. uair do gabatar do lāimh nach
lēigfidis tocrādh a tigerna tairsib, ML² 1527. in fil tochradh
duit at bethaidh saegulta, Études Celt. ii 289.22. as é an
maccrádh ga dám dó | crádh óna mó an tacrádh thrá,
IGT Decl. ex. 380. ar n-achlán do lín dá ló | gním óna mó
ar dtachrádh trá, ex. 412. táraidh dá t. re treall | gur
sháraigh ochlán Éireann, DDána 73.4. is tocrádh mór
marbhnadh Dé, Dán Dé xxvi 1. tochrádh naomh gibé do
neath, Content. vi 247. is tuar toccráidh, TSh. 1968. ba
tochradh menman la Nél in ro himredh dettualang for-
rosomh, Leb. Gab. 194.27. an neoch tuc tochradh menman
┐ aigenta dham, ITS v 40.3. bá tochrádh mór menman
lais a bheith amhlaidh sin i ndaorbhroitt, FM vi 1894.3.

eg.p: see *do-accráidi.

egForm.p:
i,f. vn. of *do-dáili. act of pouring out;
draught: in todáil gl. austum, Ml 79a5. huan todail feuchuir
gl. fero austu, 134b4. donaib todalib gl. austibus, 30d1.
huanaib todailib gl. austibus, 118c8. attib tadail do tofhín,
SR 6326. in tenid atchonnarcaisthi (sic) do todail (.i. do
sgailed) damhsa ignis quem vidisti ex me exeuntem, Arch. iii
10.18. rotindscan in dīliu todail for in mbith `to pour,' Ériu
ii 140 § 143. gaoth et ferthain aga t. forro, Aisl. Tund. 111.5.
ní slan sam-todail samraid | tamh Partolain for Breghmaig,
Leb. Gab. 68.3. Breccán cen samh-thódail sláin | mac
Partholáin in prím-fháith, Met. Dinds. iv 82.30. Of shedd-
ing blood: tre ráon slogh ┐ tré todhail fhola, CCath. 361.
gan for cru do todail, 3565. is lainbecc da fhuil bad dutracht
lasin occlach ... do thodail ass, 5104. roshantaigset togail
na fola, TTr. 2212. rolín a shainnt do thodhail fhola na T.,
TTr.² 163. conach deacair ... leo todhail cru fola shil
Ughoine mháir in gach airm fogabatt aon díob, ZCP xiv
230.12. intí tairmescus a claidhem o toghail fola in pecth-
aigh gl. qui proibet gladiam suam a sanguinis peccatoris,
O'Don. 713 (H.3.17, col. 520). gan todhail cró ┐ snidhe
fola ... etarra, Hugh Roe 298.14.

eg.p: see *do-dáili.
see taidiúire.

egForm.p:
u, m. vn. formation from *to-di-ess-ro-sní—.
pain, torture: in todernam gl. suplicio, Ml 27c20. dito-
dérnamaib inchlidib gl. suppliciis, 40a7. hi pein fotai ┐
hi todernam, 77a13. is ansu cech todáernam, 133a4. t. gl.
supplicium, Sg. 133b1. an doberar do thodérnamaib for
anmannaib duíne, LU 1363. conaccatár piána ┐ todérnama,
LU 1957 (FA 2). cia piannad no cia todernam doberthi
form, LB 234b20. ní airechdais saeth na pein na todernam
ind iffirn, Ériu ii 142 § 154. asbert ar a tabraidis to[d]ernuma
forru co ndebraidis firindi, BB 496b21. ar bat nefni fiadu
na todernuma ┐ na piana tuctha fair, PH 6590. díanaig co
tódernam ┐ co péin suthain, PH 1818. dpl. somet. toder-
naib: i todernaib ithfrinn, Lism. L. 2762. o thódernaib
imdaib, PH 4274. i todernaib diamra, 4276.

o, ā (todérnam) painful: is todernamach
bar m-betha, Alex. 918. is snimach ┐ is todernumach
saidbres ┐ sommatu in shaeguilsea, PH 4257.

[io, iā part. of *to-di-ess-ro-sní-. twisted, tor-
tuous: todernide .i. snithe gl. tortuosae, Ml 24b7.

eg.p: Taurain t. tuiridh, Gorm. Aug. 11. Cf. todail ?

egForm.p:
(B. na f.) act of counting: tódine (.i. āiremh) a būan
(.i. a maithusa), ZCP v 487 § 12.

eg.p: see taidiúir.
see do-díuschi.

form.p: u, m. vn. of do-díuschi.

eg.p:
(a) act of wakening:
amal as ṅdínim la nech todiusgud nach aili á suan, Ml
61b28. todiusgud néich do chretim, Wb 12c39.

(b) act of
stirring up, exciting; precept dosom didiu et todiuschud,
Wb 8a4. is t. étlac, Fél. Ep. 193. combí todiuscad accobir
in membris, Mon. Tall. 152.2. math dondí remibi dó
dognether dodiuscuth inna debta, Ériu vii 162.13.

(c) act of restoring to life, resuscitating: ní ecen a thodiusgud;
asreracht cene a mortuis, Wb 4d27. as tualang deacht
todiusgud crist et omnium mortuorum, 13c15. naeim
Hērenn do accomul in oenmaigin for lige Fergusa maic
Róich ┐ tredan trī laa co n-aidchi for in gcuimdid imo
thodūscud dūib, Arch. iii 3.30. a screbull a todúsc[th]e
as fee for bringing him back to life, 226.2. suscitatio .i.
toduscud marb tria mírbail iar ndesmirecht Lazáir, LU
2709. bá mór trá a cumachta do P. .i. todúscad Con Culaind
íarna bith .ix. cét bliadna hi talmain, 9541. conerbairt
fris tódiuscud na mbó, Trip. 12.28. dia thodúscud do P.,
220.23. dia bethugud ┐ dia thodúscad a talmain, LB
257a53. creid toduscadh fer(r) ndomun, ZCP vi 84.15.
tāinic Diarmait cucutt-sa ar dāig todiusctha Bresail a maic
dō, vii 306.33. doberar iarsin a mac don rīg iarna t., 306.z.
a mac ... do chur a n-ifren do thocbail ┐ da thoduscad L.,
TTebe 582. tre tuduscad anmand a hifren, TTebe 1635.
see tadlach.
see tothlugud.

egForm.p:
io, iā part. formation from *do-doichbí cf.,
KZ xxxvii 392; Ped. ii 674.z.) future: taircetul raet t.,
Thr. Hom. 2.15. isin bethaid thodóchaide, 2928. for
na hulcu frecnarci ┐ tódochaide, 4121. intan raide int
shillaib toisich, todachaiche chugut int shillab dedenach
`the last syllable is future to you,' Auraic. 91.

As subst. (io, n.) future time: buíth dunni issin todochidiu
.i. vita futura, Wb 12c7. eter imnetha in betho frecṅdirc
et pœna todóchidi, 14b10. dugena dano innahí tairngir hisa
todochide gl. in futurum, Ml 50d10. ar is t. n-airchend ind
esergi fein, LU 2614. Grammat. future tense: frecndairc
comaccumuil ar t. nindideto, Ml 61a18. t. gair biuc iartain,
Sg. 147a7. cruthaigtheo na ranngabal todochaidi, 191b2.
Later iā, f. future time: ria techt dochum na todóchaide,
BColm. 46.15. co fil remfis na todocaide do leire linn,
CCath. 4063. fiss na t., BB 16b24. an sagart tuaithcill
tuigsenach na todochaidi, TTebe 1190. in fer tuaichill
tuicsenach da thodochaidhe, 2962. uile rúine ┐ derrite na
tódochaide, PH 5912. uair roba reimfhisid ar todóchaide
é, SG 395.6. t. .i. ini nach tainic fos, Lec. Gl. 406. todhóch-
aidhe .i. an aimsir nach ttainicc, O'Cl.

ā, f. (todochaide) future: co fégad De isin
t. (sic leg. MS. tochidecht) ┐ isi tinfiud h-ita, LB 251b1.

[ā, f.] See todiuscud. act of raising from the
dead: cuinghis forra a shéitigh do th. dó, BNnÉ 5.16.
guidhis Dia um an mac do thodhusacht, 295.25 v.l. (thódús-
ccadh, text.) imo tódúsacht, 37.

form.p:
ā, f. (but cf. ds. táu, Corm. Y 1204; ZCP viii 329.26).
Originally an s-stem, see Ped. i 55. ns. toa, ZCP xiii 272 § 21.
tuäe, Arch. iii 314 § 29. tua, Ériu ii 64 § 4. tua, TBC 3333.
tó, ZCP iii 23.10. toei, PH 630. toe, Auraic. 909. ds. toë,
SR 1586. tāi, Ériu ii 229 § 2. toei, PH 625. as. tuai, Ml
58c5. túi, Ériu iv 30.23. apl. tuai, Ml 112b3.

egForm.p:
silence: in tuai gl. selentium, Ml 58c5. inna tuai gl.
silentia, 112b3. adram in coimdid 'mole | hi toe, cen
chomlabrae, SR 1586. toreic .i. reic tho .i. aisneis i táu
(toi, LB), Corm. Y 1204. croisfigell hi tói, Rawl. B 512
fo. 39a (Plummer MS. Notes). tuae ocus fethamlae | do
chrábud rop lessach, Ériu iii 100 § 21. cech toi bad ernaigthi,
cech labrau bud ḟirinde, Flower Cat. 493.4. ce do faidsad
snathat for lar in taige rocluinfide lasin túi i mbítis ar a
airmitin som, Ériu iv 30.23. descaid trebaire túae, Anecd.
iii 15.12. tó co toiscide, ZCP iii 25.10. tva co comlabra,
447.4. tuae ┐ trebaire, xi 86 § 42. is ē dliged na mban beth
i tāi, Anecd. v 23 n. 13. ro forcongairt forro táei do denum,
CCath. 573 v.l. ro tuilset ... lasin tai moir sin, 4365. gurba
toir cach gan sgath ┐ gurba tiar cach gan taoi, ZCP x 287.19.
cen toi fri ortt, BNnÉ 305.27. doronsat tái d'eistecht
frisan righ, 324.30. hi toei moir, PH 625. ro-thuit toei mor
forsin imper, 630. toe tengadh, Auraic. 909. ata-boing
... tui teachtaid fili, 5458. fírinne i n-aghaidh ghó | agus
tó i n-aghaidh labhra, Dánfhocail 230. iar mbeith dhósomh
seatal ina thaoi, Hugh Roe 230.15. As vn.: do thai ┐
d'urestecht friss, CCath. 5031. bric chorcra ar taoi a dtio-
mánghoibhnigh, DDána 89.23. to .i. tost, Lec. Gl. 347. tua
.i. tó ainche .i. tosd, O'Cl. Hence: to .i. bas, ut est mad
im tir ro temhadh tó, O'Dav. 1554 = tó .i. bás ut est, ma
im thir ro temadh to .i. da madh im thir ro epled sé a mbas.
tó .i. bas quod tacet omnis in morte, O'C. 978 (H. 3. 18,
422b). ? an toe toe | do ní mac Conaing don roi, FM i 508.y.
As n.pr.: Agnomain, Tōe, Banb, Ält. Ir. Dicht. i 42 § 43.
Ogaman. Tōi (: gōi), 54 § 18. ronn-ain itge Tuäe, Fél.
Dec. 22. Toí. Uimle, Hidna, Fél.² clxxxv 7. isí Blonac
ingen Túi | ic sádud a crúi rosmill, Met. Dinds. iii 376.3.

eg.p: See tá, 2 tóe.

form.p:
io, iā Cf. 1 tóe. ns. tai, Leb. Gab. i 66.15. toe, LL
360 marg. inf. tua, Arch. Hib. ii 54 (iii § 2). tō, Arch. iii
300 § 10. tue, O'Mulc. 686. toi, Lism. L. 2974. túi, Anecd.
ii 33 (xvii § 2). toé, Ériu iii 96 § 2. asn. tó, LL 208b31.
gsn. toi, RC xxviii 322 § 50. gsf. túäe, Hy. ii.20. dsf. thue,
Rawl. 72b6. toi, SR 4715.

eg.p:
silent: bid fās tír Temrach túäe (: núae), Hy. 2.20.
rola nel di cach treib toi | iarsin in scel roimchlóe, SR 4715.
beō dianid bēs teöir thō (: lō), Arch. iii 306 § 10. nilabar ni
toe tauthe torc, Bodl. Corm. 28.1. ba remib ro mebaid |
nīr bo debaid tua | ... in cath i sleib Chua, Arch. Hib. ii
54 (iii § 2). dorusim maccu aili o Chethura .i. ón mnai thue
iar nec Sarra, Rawl. 72b6. Appolloin tói thogaim, Gorm.
April 10. to od, tae a ed intan as femen, Auraic. 1473.
bad toé díscéoil a monar | úathad mbríathar nád labair,
Ériu iii 96 § 2. o ra-sia in tech teinmech tó, Ériu vii 222 §
25. rucsat air ar in traigh tái, viii 54.21. dorrīadat rīg
rānmessaig, | rí tūathe, nī tōe (: cóe), ZCP v 499 § 8. tóchel
an righthoighe thoi, RC xxviii 322 § 50. ba tuí a thuil fo
dámaib, LL 5b50. ciar bo túi nir bo thibri, 44b21. rí dosrat
fa thalmain toe | mairg nach adrand for bithce, 154a38.
ba-sa to fhásaig, 343d40. dobere do timna, nī tōi | do
c[h]āch co himdha, ZCP vi 266 § 9. nā bud sgēlach cēili-
dhech ... ba tāi cean briathra ūabair, vii 311 § 9. oirecht
némnech tói tuaichell, LB 124b11. ni ro bo toi do lucht
in betha in tan ro chesair-suim, 240a30. roloisc in tene ...
dóite ┐ rígthe na n-dibercach, gurbo toi tuaithgerrtha iat,
Lism. L. 2974. Mag Fea, nír thréic, ciarbo thúi | Fea ben
Néit maic Indúi, Met. Dinds. iii 198.21. atchíat fotholl
tói talman, 250.103. ba ferr cach mnái, ciarbo thúi, ii 44.39.
o na trenaib dian treb thoí | cen goí co ngénair mac Dé,
iv 96.59. Bioth, nir bo toi (.i. tostach) a tonnbann, Leb.
Gab. i 60.1. ba tai a tuir fo tamaib (.i. ba tostánach a
triatha), 66.15. dleaghar dhínn marbhnadh truagh taoi |
dá ghruadh gé ro marbhadh mé, Dán Dé xxvi 3. mo ghlór
re Dia is treabhadh taoi, 19. Cf. scíath tái tailgel fair,
MU² 725. `táoi' bodhar nach dis, Met. Gl. 15.34. taoi
.i. bodhar. taoi .i. tosd, O'Cl. Compar.: som is taitiu
innas in aill, Auraic. 1480. tod .i. tai a od in tan as bindi
is tuíu ┐ is isliu ata anaill, BB 327b40.

egForm.p:
In adv. phr. co toi silently: mo bennacht co túi, Anecd.
ii 34 (19 § 5). acht roscaíl in tríath co taí | in Líath ocus
in láech-mnaí, Met. Dinds. iv 228.19. oc a munad co toich,
no co tai, Laws v 490.19 Comm. hí tír tarngire co túi, Met.
Dinds. iii 286.9. ra fleghaidhsiot go taoi feitheamhail i
maille andsin, TFrag. 26.18. go taoi terclabarthach,
Caithr. Thoirdh. 72.20. tangadar ... co tai taithenach co
ruigi in inad sin, TTebe 911. go táoi tóithenach, Hugh
Roe 78.10. do gluaisedur rompo ... co tai, tostadhach,
AU iii 136.16. roimigh asan cathraigh amach co tai tos-
tadhach, ZCP vi 47.22. ro táíetar lucht in tsídhe uile co
tái tostadhach, Acall. 404.

eg.p:
In nn.pr.: Domnall mac Tigernāin tūi, ZCP ix 468.5.
Maine Tái .i. Maine amhlabar .i. nír bho raítech é sechach
chách, Cóir Anm. 230. Fer-tái, Fianaig. 68.24. Fir thai,
69.26.

egForm.p:
As subst. silent, dumb person: dá mac Dathó insin.
buidir amlabair ammathair ┐ anathair, RC xviii 52.4, but
cf. O'Rahilly, Early Ir. History 485.4.

eg.p:
Compd. thir silent land: Segein ro siacht toethir | la
Boethin nar borbaig, Gorm. Jan. 29.

egForm.p:
o, ā (1 tóe) silent: bid follus ... doraga in comdiu
... ┐ nibá toíthenach, LU 2364. innill tothanach imcoimét,
Laws i 37 n. 3. is tothanach in t-eitsecht, 38.1 Comm.
rí (sic leg.) trócar táetheanach, ZCP viii 199.17. co tai,
tastach, toithenach, CCath. 500. co tostach t., 517. telguba
tromm tóethinach, Alex. 267. tangadar ... co tai taithenach
co ruigi in inad sin, TTebe 911. tuic let ... na Tiabanda
taetencha, 1232. in ri toirrsech taetanach anband, 1379.
tic slog ... taitnemach toethinach, PH 8319. go taoi tostach
táoithenach, Fl. Earls 236.5. go taoí tóithenach, Hugh
Roe 78.10. gabaitt na Goill occá n-eideadh go taoi taoi-
theanach, FM vi 2214.17.

eg.p:
Abstract toethenche: tothainci dogni ar dia, Fél.²
clxxxiii 30.
see tothla.
see *tobairthi.

egForm.p:
u, m. vn. of do-fásci. act of squeezing (out): feibh
nó faisccfed neach caera fíni etir a glacoibh ag tofasgadh
fionoi eistibh, Aisl. Tund. 109.10. lind dēr ait[h]rige, lind
tofaiscthi fola hi pennaind, ZCP iii 453.30. ni ba hecen
do acht tofascad a dá glac co snigtis richsi feined a suilib
a mér `to wring his two hands,' Dinds. § 62. t. segsa name
of a metre: toasgad segsa innso, IT iii 102 § 189.

eg.p: see tafann.

form.p:
Indecl. n. in O. Ir. but later io, n. (cf. Thurn.
Gramm. § 341). (m. and) f. togha, tagha, IGT Decl. § 3
(44.33). vn. of do-goa. Cf. roga.

egForm.p:
(a) act of choosing; choice, will, wish: togu indalanái, Wb
4c13. tairchechuin ... togu geinte, 40. huand airigid .i.
huan togu, Ml 123a13. roboi dethiden mór oca togu són,
131c13. t. ngle, SR 5439. ainm Póil, buan a togu, Fél. Prol.
123. togu damsa anísin, Thes. ii 225.18. fria n-athnugud
fria togo | robátar in hEricho, SR 6723. adchuass dó
bare Patraic fris di thogu ┐ baithis ┐ nem do thairgiri dondí
aratallsom `election,' Trip. 164.26. iar fācbail a rigi ┐ iar t.
na beatha coimdeata isin tor-sin, Lec. 301vb26. bid hé
mo thogasa dano dul chucutsu, TBFr.² 165. ar ba hé a t.
